Hornet/HORNET_GREENPATH.Zh: 站住，异乡人。<page>我看见了你在林间的身影。你不是圣巢的虫子，身上的武器也不属于这里。<page>这座王国里有可怕的东西正在苏醒。来自泰拉的本领，未必能让你安然穿过它的梦。<page>想继续前进，就让我看看你的决心。
Hornet/HORNET_GREENPATH.En: Stop, outsider.<page>I saw you moving through the undergrowth. You are no bug of Hallownest, and those weapons are foreign to this land.<page>Something terrible is waking in this kingdom. Your Terrarian skills may not carry you safely through its dreams.<page>If you mean to proceed, show me your resolve.

Hornet/HORNET_FOUNTAIN_1.Zh: 我们又见面了，泰拉旅人。<page>我原以为你只是来废墟寻宝，看来低估了你。<page>你见过王国之外的世界，也带来了这里没有的技艺。<page>不过，要理解圣巢，还得看清它以什么代价维持至今。
Hornet/HORNET_FOUNTAIN_1.En: We meet again, Terrarian.<page>I thought you merely sought treasure in these ruins. I underestimated you.<page>You have seen a world beyond this kingdom and brought unfamiliar skills.<page>To understand Hallownest, you must also understand the price that has kept it standing.

Hornet/HORNET_FOUNTAIN_2.Zh: 若了解真相之后，你仍愿意帮助圣巢，就去寻找灰烬中的坟墓。<page>那里留下的标记能打开旧王的道路，却不会让你成为他的子嗣。
Hornet/HORNET_FOUNTAIN_2.En: If you still wish to help Hallownest after learning its truth, seek the grave in ash.<page>The mark left there opens the old king's roads. It will not make you his child.

Hornet/HORNET_OUTSKIRTS_1.Zh: 你还要继续追查吗，泰拉旅人？前方的真相很沉重，带再多装备也不能替你作出选择。
Hornet/HORNET_OUTSKIRTS_1.En: Will you keep searching, Terrarian? The truth ahead is a heavy burden. No amount of equipment can make your choice for you.

Hornet/HORNET_OUTSKIRTS_2.Zh: 想继续，就证明你已做好准备。我的针不会因为你来自异乡就留情。<page>你无需继承这个王国的血脉，但必须明白自己将触动什么。
Hornet/HORNET_OUTSKIRTS_2.En: Prove you are ready if you mean to continue. My needle will not spare you for being foreign.<page>You need not inherit this kingdom's blood, but you must understand what you are about to disturb.

Hornet/HORNET_OUTSKIRTS_DEFEAT.Zh: ……这样的力量。泰拉的战士果然不能小看。<page>你已经赢得前进的资格。可你知道，这枚标记背后埋着多少牺牲吗？<page>去看清它。把标记带走，凭自己的意志决定如何使用，别让一位死去的国王替你选择。
Hornet/HORNET_OUTSKIRTS_DEFEAT.En: ...Such strength. A Terrarian warrior is not to be underestimated.<page>You have earned the right to proceed. Do you know how much sacrifice lies behind that mark?<page>See for yourself. Take it, and decide how to use it. Do not let a dead king choose for you.

Hornet/HORNET_DOOR_UNOPENED.Zh: 你走得很远，泰拉旅人。守梦者的封印已不能拦住你。<page>接下来面对的不是你失落的身世，而是圣巢留下的难题。弄清自己的选择，再打开最后的大门。
Hornet/HORNET_DOOR_UNOPENED.En: You have come far, Terrarian. The Dreamers' seals can no longer bar your way.<page>What awaits is not your forgotten origin, but Hallownest's unresolved tragedy. Understand your choice before opening the final door.

Hornet/HORNET_ABYSS_ASCENT_01.Zh: 你从深渊回来了，泰拉旅人，还学会了借用那里的暗影。<page>那里是容器们被创造和遗弃的地方，并不是你的故乡。不要把它们的命运当成自己的宿命。<page>但你能走出黑暗，确实给了我希望。<page>接下来的路由你选择：延续封印，或者设法直面感染的核心。
Hornet/HORNET_ABYSS_ASCENT_01.En: You returned from the Abyss, Terrarian, carrying its shadow.<page>That is where the Vessels were made and discarded. It is not your birthplace. Their fate need not become yours.<page>Still, your return from that darkness gives me hope.<page>The next choice is yours: sustain the seal, or seek a way to confront the infection at its heart.

Hornet/HORNET_ABYSS_REPEAT.Zh: 泰拉旅人，我希望你能找到比延续封印更好的办法。但最终的选择，必须出自你自己的意志。
Hornet/HORNET_ABYSS_REPEAT.En: Terrarian, I hope you find something better than another seal. But the final choice must be your own.

Hornet/HORNET_ABYSS_DREAM.Zh: ……有血有肉的异乡人，竟能承受那片黑暗……也许我们的旧办法并不是唯一的路……
Hornet/HORNET_ABYSS_DREAM.En: ...An outsider of flesh and blood endured that darkness... Perhaps our old answer is not the only path...

Hornet/HORNET_PRE_FINAL_BATTLE.Zh: 道路已经打开，泰拉旅人。黑卵里等着的是这个王国的旧债，不是你的出生之谜。<page>里面的束缚和感染对你我都很危险。我会留在外面，寻找能够出手的时机。<page>你不欠圣巢一条命。若仍要进去，就带上你信任的装备，记住自己为何而战。
Hornet/HORNET_PRE_FINAL_BATTLE.En: The way is open, Terrarian. The Black Egg holds this kingdom's old debt, not the secret of your birth.<page>Its bindings and infection endanger us both. I will wait outside for an opening.<page>You do not owe Hallownest your life. If you enter, take the equipment you trust and remember why you fight.

Hornet/HORNET_PRE_FINAL_BATTLE_REPEAT.Zh: 来自泰拉的战士，你已经能改变这个王国的结局。别把自己当成另一只注定牺牲的容器。找到你愿意承担的道路。
Hornet/HORNET_PRE_FINAL_BATTLE_REPEAT.En: Warrior of Terraria, you can change this kingdom's ending. Do not mistake yourself for another Vessel destined for sacrifice. Find a path you choose to bear.

Hornet/HORNET_PRE_FINAL_BATTLE_DREAM.Zh: ……我们未曾找到的出路，真会由这位泰拉旅人找到吗？……
Hornet/HORNET_PRE_FINAL_BATTLE_DREAM.En: ...Will this Terrarian find the way out that we never could?...

Hornet/HORNET_FINAL_BOSS.Zh: 就是现在，泰拉旅人！我的丝线撑不了多久！<page>要维持封印，还是直面感染的核心——用你的行动作出选择！
Hornet/HORNET_FINAL_BOSS.En: Now, Terrarian! My threads will not hold for long!<page>Preserve the seal, or confront the infection at its heart. Make your choice!

Hornet/HORNET_SPIDER_TOWN_01.Zh: 你已经让那头野兽安息了……也让我的母亲终于能结束守望。<page>泰拉旅人，我不会阻止你，但这并不意味着我毫无痛苦。<page>她的选择使我得以出生。我感谢她，也无法轻易看着她离去。<page>你与我们的家族没有血缘，却承担了这一步。至少，让我独自向她告别。
Hornet/HORNET_SPIDER_TOWN_01.En: The beast is at rest... and my mother's watch can finally end.<page>Terrarian, I will not stop you. That does not mean this causes me no pain.<page>Her choice allowed me to be born. I am grateful, and cannot easily watch her go.<page>You share no blood with our family, yet have taken this step. At least let me say farewell alone.

Hornet/HORNET_SPIDER_TOWN_REPEAT.Zh: 让我独自待一会儿，泰拉旅人。在这间卧室彻底成为陵墓之前。
Hornet/HORNET_SPIDER_TOWN_REPEAT.En: Leave me a moment, Terrarian, before this chamber becomes nothing but a tomb.

Dreamers/DREAMERS_EC1_1A.Zh:
异乡人会打破封印？
封印不能被打破。
封印必须被打破。来自泰拉的旅人，让我们继续沉睡。
Dreamers/DREAMERS_EC1_1A.En:
Will the outsider break the seal?
The seal cannot be broken.
The seal must be broken.Traveller from Terraria, let us sleep.

Dreamers/DREAMERS_EC1_4.Zh:
让我们继续沉睡，泰拉旅人。
离开这座与你无血缘之系的王国。
给我们安宁。
Dreamers/DREAMERS_EC1_4.En:
Let us sleep, Terrarian.
Leave this kingdom, to which no blood binds you.
Give us peace.

Dreamers/DREAMERS_EC2_1.Zh:
异乡人将触碰封印。
封印不能被打破。
封印必须被打破。空的容器曾带来希望。强大的容器留下停滞。
但这位泰拉人并非容器。另一种意志，能带来终结，还是新的灾难？
Dreamers/DREAMERS_EC2_1.En:
The outsider will touch the seal.
The seal cannot be broken.
The seal must be broken.An empty Vessel promised hope. A mighty Vessel left stagnation.
But this Terrarian is no Vessel. Will another will bring an end, or a new disaster?

Dreamers/DREAMERS_EC2_1A.Zh: 不要再前进了，泰拉旅人。

Dreamers/DREAMERS_EC2_1A_2.Zh: 是什么让这位泰拉人离开自己的世界，深入我们衰败的王国？
Dreamers/DREAMERS_EC2_1A_2.En: What brought this Terrarian away from their own world and into our fallen kingdom?

Dreamers/DREAMERS_EC2_1F.Zh: 这位异乡人必须被放逐。
Dreamers/DREAMERS_EC2_1F.En: This outsider must be cast out.

Dreamers/DREAMERS_EC2_2.Zh:
离去吧，泰拉旅人。

离去，让我们安静地沉睡。
Dreamers/DREAMERS_EC2_2.En:
Leave, Terrarian.

Leave us to our quiet sleep.

Lore Tablets/TUT_TAB_01.Zh:
石碑上刻着一段留给旅人的旧训。

来自泰拉的旅人，圣巢曾以灵魂驱动技艺。学习它们时，也别忘了你从故乡带来的工具与本领。
前路需要的不是高贵出身，而是准备和判断。
Lore Tablets/TUT_TAB_01.En:
An old lesson is carved here for travellers.

Traveller from Terraria, Hallownest once shaped its arts through Soul. Learn them, but remember the tools and skills of your homeland.
The road ahead demands preparation and judgement, not noble birth.

Lore Tablets/TUT_TAB_02.Zh:
圣巢的界碑。

旅人，越过此处，便进入旧王的领土。
碑上要求来者遵守王国的律法。“最后而永恒的文明——圣巢。”

如今，来自泰拉的你只能在废墟中辨认这句许诺。
Lore Tablets/TUT_TAB_02.En:
A boundary stone of Hallownest.

Traveller, beyond this threshold lies the old king's realm.
The inscription demands obedience to its laws."The last and eternal civilisation: Hallownest."

Coming from Terraria, you can now judge that promise only by its ruins.

Lore Tablets/TUT_TAB_03.Zh:
一段写给古代生灵的训诫。

旧王命令自己的造物显露真形，以威严统御虫群。
这是圣巢曾经的信条，并不是对泰拉旅人血统的宣告。
Lore Tablets/TUT_TAB_03.En:
An admonition addressed to ancient beings.

The old king ordered his creations to reveal their true forms and command the bugs' awe.
This was Hallownest's creed, not a declaration of a Terrarian traveller's ancestry.

Lore Tablets/CLIFF_TAB_02.Zh:
风化的界碑警告：离开王国，便会失去心智；荒原之外，再无世界。来自泰拉的旅人知道，世界并未在这里终结。
这是旧王对臣民留下的警告，不是你的来历。
Lore Tablets/CLIFF_TAB_02.En:
A weathered boundary stone warns that leaving the kingdom means losing one's mind, and that no world lies beyond the wastes.A traveller from Terraria knows the world does not end here.
This is an old king's warning to his subjects, not an account of your origin.

Lore Tablets/ABYSS_TUT_TAB_01.Zh:
封闭深渊的旧碑。

“被选中的容器已经升起。余下的只有被舍弃者，与创造它们的悔恨。我们不会再次进入此地。”碑文记述的是圣巢创造容器的往事。泰拉旅人，你正站在那场悲剧的门外。
Lore Tablets/ABYSS_TUT_TAB_01.En:
An old stone sealing the Abyss.

"The chosen Vessel has risen. Only the rejected, and regret for their creation, remain. We shall not enter again."The stone records Hallownest's creation of the Vessels. Terrarian, you stand outside that tragedy, looking in.

Lore Tablets/SENSE_TAB_01.Zh:
这是留给被封印容器的记录：

“即使身受束缚，也应知晓外界的状况。圣巢终将再次完整。”泰拉旅人，碑文所称的容器并不是你。那是一项早已许下、尚未兑现的承诺。
Lore Tablets/SENSE_TAB_01.En:
A record left for the bound Vessel:

"Though bound, you should know the state of the world. Hallownest shall be whole again."Terrarian, the Vessel addressed here is not you. This is an old promise still unfulfilled.

Lore Tablets/PILGRIM_TAB_01.Zh:
朝圣者之路。
来自泰拉的旅人，也可以沿着青翠的野地与蘑菇林前往王国中心。
旧碑许诺那里藏着希望与真相。如今是否仍然如此，要由你亲眼确认。
Lore Tablets/PILGRIM_TAB_01.En:
The Pilgrim's Way.
A traveller from Terraria may follow the green wilds and fungal groves towards the kingdom's heart.
The old stone promises hope and truth there. You must see for yourself what remains.

Lore Tablets/PILGRIM_TAB_02.Zh:
朝圣者之路在此结束。
圣巢的旧日中心就在前方。
旅人，谨慎前行；荣耀的许诺仍刻在石上，守门的人却已不在。
Lore Tablets/PILGRIM_TAB_02.En:
The Pilgrim's Way ends here.
The old heart of Hallownest lies ahead.
Traveller, proceed carefully. The promise of glory remains in stone, but its gatekeepers are gone.

Lore Tablets/RUIN_TAB_01.Zh:
封城告示：
大门封闭，禁止出入。
没有为异乡旅人留下的例外。
Lore Tablets/RUIN_TAB_01.En:
A city lockdown notice:
Gates sealed. No entry or departure.
No exception is recorded for foreign travellers.

Lore Tablets/RUIN_TAB_02.Zh:
石面上留下了臣民的恳求：
“失踪的君王，请回来。疯狂正在蔓延，我们需要你。”这声音属于旧日的圣巢。来自泰拉的你，只能读到求救后的寂静。
Lore Tablets/RUIN_TAB_02.En:
A plea from the subjects remains in stone:
"Missing king, return. Madness spreads. We need you."The voice belongs to old Hallownest. Coming from Terraria, you find only the silence after its plea.

Lore Tablets/RUINS_FOUNTAIN.Zh:
空洞骑士纪念碑。
“它被安置在高处的黑卵之中，以牺牲换取圣巢的永恒。”泰拉旅人，这座碑纪念的是曾经承担封印的骑士，并非你的过去。
Lore Tablets/RUINS_FOUNTAIN.En:
A monument to the Hollow Knight.
"Within the Black Egg above, its sacrifice preserves Hallownest for eternity."Terrarian, this monument honours the Knight who bore the seal. It does not recount your past.

Lore Tablets/MANTIS_PLAQUE_01.Zh:
螳螂部族的战书：
寻求挑战的漫游者，欢迎。无论来自圣巢还是泰拉，都须以实力证明自己。
我们的利爪不会因来客的身份而留情。
Lore Tablets/MANTIS_PLAQUE_01.En:
A challenge from the mantis tribe:
Wanderer seeking a trial, welcome. Hallownest or Terraria, all visitors must prove their strength.
Our claws make no allowance for your origin.

Lore Tablets/MANTIS_PLAQUE_02.Zh:
旧日的停战约定仍然有效。
螳螂继续守夜，阻挡边界另一侧的野兽。
过路的旅人，请勿把这份守望误当作臣服。
Lore Tablets/MANTIS_PLAQUE_02.En:
The old truce still holds.
The mantises keep watch against the beasts beyond the border.
Passing traveller, do not mistake their vigil for submission.

Lore Tablets/WISHING_WELL_INSPECT.Zh:
旧王的许愿池。
碑文劝臣民将财富尽献王国，称苍白之王会为他们解除负担。
泰拉旅人，是否投下吉欧，由你自己决定。
Lore Tablets/WISHING_WELL_INSPECT.En:
The old king's wishing well.
The inscription asks subjects to give their wealth to the kingdom, promising that the Pale King will relieve their burden.
Terrarian, whether to offer Geo is your choice.

Lore Tablets/WP_WORKSHOP_01.Zh:
旧王工坊的研究记录：
虚空拥有与光相反的力量，也许能抵抗岁月。
研究者试图驾驭它。石碑没有写出失败的代价。
Lore Tablets/WP_WORKSHOP_01.En:
A research record from the king's workshop:
Void opposes light, and may resist time itself.
The researcher sought to command it. The stone does not state the price of failure.

Lore Tablets/WP_THRONE_01.Zh:
王座旁的残文：
旧日之光被驱逐，沃姆化身灯塔，以意志统御臣民。
永恒的许诺，却为后世留下了诅咒。这不是泰拉旅人的王位，而是一个王国尚未结清的债。
Lore Tablets/WP_THRONE_01.En:
Fragments beside a throne:
The old light was cast out. Wyrm became a beacon and ruled his subjects through will.
The promise of eternity left a curse to later generations.This is no Terrarian traveller's throne, but a kingdom's unsettled debt.

Lore Tablets/ARCHIVE_01.Zh:
档案碎片：
胚胎……外壳……容纳光……
容器……封印……守梦者环绕……
这些断裂的记录指向一项以生命维持封印的计划。
Lore Tablets/ARCHIVE_01.En:
Archive fragments:
Embryos... shells... contain the light...
Vessels... seals... Dreamers surrounding...
The broken record points to a plan that sustained a seal through living sacrifice.

Lore Tablets/ARCHIVE_02.Zh:
档案碎片：
王之光带来心智，旧日之光仍存于梦中。
信仰退却，记忆未灭。
记录到这里变得混乱，像是研究者也无法摆脱那个梦。
Lore Tablets/ARCHIVE_02.En:
Archive fragments:
The king's light grants thought. The old light remains in dreams.
Belief recedes; memory endures.
The record grows confused, as though its author could not escape that dream.

Lore Tablets/ARCHIVE_03.Zh:
档案碎片：
以外壳容纳液态的虚空……王与根的造物……
它们被称为容器。泰拉旅人，这是对古老实验的记载，不是对你身体的描述。
Lore Tablets/ARCHIVE_03.En:
Archive fragments:
Liquid Void held within shells... creations of king and root...
They were called Vessels.Terrarian, this describes an ancient experiment, not your body.

Lore Tablets/FUNG_TAB_01.Zh:
真菌部族的旧约：
接受沃姆的旨意，相信他的预言会庇护我们。
让命运与王国的未来缠绕。如今，旅人只能在废墟中寻找这个约定的结局。
Lore Tablets/FUNG_TAB_01.En:
An old pact of the fungal tribe:
Accept the Wyrm's will. Trust his foresight to shelter us.
Let our fate entwine with the kingdom's future.Now a traveller must seek the pact's ending among ruins.

Lore Tablets/FUNG_TAB_02.Zh:
碑文向来客请求怜悯。
这些生灵的思想困在孤寂之中，言语只剩下微弱的影子。
泰拉旅人，听不懂它们，并不代表它们从未想过表达。
Lore Tablets/FUNG_TAB_02.En:
The stone asks visitors for compassion.
These beings' thoughts are trapped in solitude; words are only their faint shadows.
Terrarian, not understanding them does not mean they never tried to speak.

Lore Tablets/FUNG_TAB_03.Zh:
共享思想，汇聚力量。
真菌的共同心智如此记述自己。
独行者经过时，它们只能感到忧郁与陌生。
Lore Tablets/FUNG_TAB_03.En:
Shared thought gathers strength.
So the fungal mind describes itself.
When solitary travellers pass, it senses only sorrow and strangeness.

Lore Tablets/FUNG_TAB_04.Zh:
边界的警告：
另一侧的生灵，有过尊贵的父亲，也有被封印的母亲。
部族拒绝与它们共处。这是圣巢各族留下的隔阂，不是你在泰拉的家族史。
Lore Tablets/FUNG_TAB_04.En:
A warning at the border:
The creatures beyond had a noble father and a sealed mother.
The tribe refuses to share its home with them.This records Hallownest's old divisions, not your family history in Terraria.

Lore Tablets/GREEN_TABLET_01.Zh:
苔藓部族的刻文：
生命从苔藓与叶片中萌发。只要绿意仍在道路上生长，族群便不会枯萎。
Lore Tablets/GREEN_TABLET_01.En:
A mosskin inscription:
Life springs from moss and leaf. While green growth covers the paths, the tribe shall not wither.

Lore Tablets/GREEN_TABLET_02.Zh:
部族在此宣告：
越过苍白之王的道路，便应尊重乌恩的法则。
泰拉旅人也不是这片绿地的例外。
Lore Tablets/GREEN_TABLET_02.En:
The tribe declares:
Beyond the Pale King's roads, respect the laws of Unn.
A Terrarian traveller is no exception in these green lands.

Lore Tablets/GREEN_TABLET_03.Zh:
伟大的心灵梦见了树叶，于是洞穴被绿意填满。
每片灌木、每根藤蔓，都被部族视为乌恩意志的延伸。
Lore Tablets/GREEN_TABLET_03.En:
A great mind dreamed of leaves, and green life filled the caverns.
The tribe sees each bush and vine as an extension of Unn's will.

Lore Tablets/GREEN_TABLET_05.Zh:
绿色之子从梦中来到此地。
它们等待着召唤，盼望回到造物者的身边。
碑文所说的是乌恩的族群。
Lore Tablets/GREEN_TABLET_05.En:
The green children came here from a dream.
They wait for a call to return to their maker.
The stone speaks of Unn's kin.

Lore Tablets/GREEN_TABLET_06.Zh:
写给乌恩的祈愿：
请回到我们身边。你的沉默让族群疲惫，叶片正在凋零。
Lore Tablets/GREEN_TABLET_06.En:
A prayer to Unn:
Return to us. Your silence wearies the tribe, and its leaves are fading.

Lore Tablets/GREEN_TABLET_07.Zh:
部族提醒过路者：
前方洞穴住着一位苍白的生灵。她看似和善，却不与此地共享同一个梦。
来自泰拉的旅人，接近时仍须谨慎。
Lore Tablets/GREEN_TABLET_07.En:
The tribe warns passing travellers:
A pale being occupies the cavern ahead. She seems kind, but does not share this land's dream.
Traveller from Terraria, approach with care.

Lore Tablets/MAGE_COMP_01.Zh:
圣所记录，森达：
悼念那些为探索献出生命的人。他们的成果将推动进化。
研究者相信，思想的瘟疫再也无法征服他们。
Lore Tablets/MAGE_COMP_01.En:
Sanctum record, Cinda:
Mourn those who gave their lives to discovery. Their achievements shall drive our evolution.
The researchers believed no plague of thought could ever conquer them again.

Lore Tablets/MAGE_COMP_02.Zh:
圣所记录，贝拉：
操纵灵魂之前，先重塑头脑。能承受这种改变的虫子极少。
所谓通往真理的道路，已铺满失败。
Lore Tablets/MAGE_COMP_02.En:
Sanctum record, Bera:
Before manipulating Soul, reshape the mind. Few bugs survive that change.
The road they called truth is paved with failures.

Lore Tablets/MAGE_COMP_03.Zh:
圣所记录，阿巴：
头脑仍是限制。怎样摆脱束缚，获得纯粹的聚合？
问题留在石上，答题的人已经不在。
Lore Tablets/MAGE_COMP_03.En:
Sanctum record, Aba:
The mind remains a limit. How may its bonds be escaped, and pure focus attained?
The question remains in stone. Its author is gone.

Lore Tablets/BELIEVE_MOTH.Zh: 你读到了另一片世界留下的文字，泰拉旅人。<page>那些声音来自不同的心灵，却因某种缘由汇聚在此。它们未必与你熟悉的圣巢一致。<page>理解、怀疑，或只是记住它们，都由你决定。
Lore Tablets/BELIEVE_MOTH.En: You have found words from another world, Terrarian.<page>Those voices belong to different minds, gathered here for reasons of their own. They may not match the Hallownest you know.<page>Understand, doubt, or simply remember them. The choice is yours.

Lore Tablets/BELIEVE_MOTH_REPEAT.Zh: 泰拉旅人，信与不信，都由你选择。
Lore Tablets/BELIEVE_MOTH_REPEAT.En: Terrarian, belief or doubt is your choice.

Lore Tablets/BELIEVE_MOTH_02.Zh: 你破坏了那些声音的寄托。<page>即使你来自另一个世界，也未必能理解每一种信仰。听不懂的低语，也曾承载真实的思念。<page>失去它们后，留下的人又该相信什么？
Lore Tablets/BELIEVE_MOTH_02.En: You destroyed the home of those voices.<page>Coming from another world does not make every belief clear to you. Even unfamiliar whispers once carried someone's hopes.<page>Without them, what will those left behind believe?

Minor NPC/KING_ABYSS_01.Zh:
一段旧王留下的记忆，向泰拉旅人展开：
“不论付出什么代价……”
Minor NPC/KING_ABYSS_01.En:
A memory left by the old king unfolds before the Terrarian:
"No cost too great..."

Minor NPC/KING_ABYSS_02.Zh: 他要求被选中的造物没有可供思考的心智。
Minor NPC/KING_ABYSS_02.En: He demanded that his chosen creation have no mind to think.

Minor NPC/KING_ABYSS_03.Zh: 他要求那造物没有可以屈从的意志。
Minor NPC/KING_ABYSS_03.En: He demanded that it have no will to break.

Minor NPC/KING_ABYSS_04.Zh: 也没有能为苦难哭泣的声音。
Minor NPC/KING_ABYSS_04.En: Nor a voice to cry suffering.

Minor NPC/KING_ABYSS_05.Zh: 那是神与虚空共同创造的生命，不是来自泰拉的你。
Minor NPC/KING_ABYSS_05.En: That life was born of god and Void. It was not you, the traveller from Terraria.

Minor NPC/KING_ABYSS_FINAL_A.Zh: 旧王命那造物，封印在众人梦中散布瘟疫的障目之光。
Minor NPC/KING_ABYSS_FINAL_A.En: The old king charged that creation with sealing the blinding light that spread plague through dreams.

Minor NPC/KING_ABYSS_FINAL_C.Zh: 他将那容器命名为“空洞骑士”。
Minor NPC/KING_ABYSS_FINAL_C.En: He named that Vessel "the Hollow Knight".

Minor NPC/KING_ABYSS_FINAL.Zh: 记忆中的旧王，命被选中的造物封印瘟疫之光。<page>他称它为容器。<page>他称它为空洞骑士。<page>泰拉旅人，你见证了这项命令，却不属于这段身世。
Minor NPC/KING_ABYSS_FINAL.En: In the memory, the old king commands his chosen creation to seal the plague's light.<page>He calls it a Vessel.<page>He calls it the Hollow Knight.<page>Terrarian, you witnessed that command. It is not your origin.

Minor NPC/QUEEN_MEET.Zh: 哦，有客人走过长路来到了这里。这样的气息……你来自泰拉，并非我们的造物。<page>我曾等待另一只容器。如今站在面前的，却是能自己选择道路的旅人。<page>我有一半旧日的护符可以交给你。找到另一半，或许能帮助你理解圣巢的往事。是否继续，由你决定。
Minor NPC/QUEEN_MEET.En: A visitor has travelled far to reach me. That presence... you come from Terraria, not from our making.<page>I waited for another Vessel. Instead, a traveller stands here with a will of their own.<page>I can give you half an old charm. Find the other half, and it may help you understand Hallownest's past. Whether to continue is yours to decide.

Minor NPC/QUEEN_TALK_01.Zh: 我的根须能感觉到，被封印的容器正在衰弱。若任其崩溃，感染会再次夺走虫群的意志。<page>过去我们只想寻找替代者，重复那项残酷的计划。可你是有血肉、有思想的泰拉人，不能被当作空壳使用。<page>若你愿意帮助我们，就去探寻封印与感染的真相。请不要因为我的请求，就把自己当成注定的祭品。
Minor NPC/QUEEN_TALK_01.En: My roots sense the sealed Vessel weakening. If it fails, infection will claim the bugs' wills again.<page>Once we sought only a replacement for that cruel plan. But you are a Terrarian of flesh and thought, not an empty shell to be used.<page>If you wish to help, seek the truth of seal and infection. Do not take my plea as a sentence of sacrifice.

Minor NPC/QUEEN_TALK_02.Zh: 我要提醒你：囚笼虽然衰弱，其中的感染却依然强大。<page>带好你的武器、护甲和补给。泰拉人的勇气也需要充分准备来支撑。
Minor NPC/QUEEN_TALK_02.En: A warning: the prison weakens, but the infection within remains mighty.<page>Prepare your weapons, armour and supplies. Even Terrarian courage needs preparation.

Minor NPC/QUEEN_MEET_REPEAT.Zh: 做好准备再触碰封印，泰拉旅人。容器若过早被打破，多年囚禁的感染便会涌出。
Minor NPC/QUEEN_MEET_REPEAT.En: Prepare before touching the seal, Terrarian. Break the Vessel too soon, and the long-imprisoned infection will pour out.

Minor NPC/QUEEN_REPEAT_KINGSOUL.Zh: 两半旧日的灵魂终于重聚。泰拉旅人，你的坚持让我想起了往昔。<page>但这枚护符不会改变你的血统。若想追查它的核心，就去深渊寻找那场实验留下的记忆。<page>那里是容器的起点，不是你的出生之地。
Minor NPC/QUEEN_REPEAT_KINGSOUL.En: The two halves of that old soul are reunited. Your persistence recalls another age, Terrarian.<page>But this charm does not change your ancestry. To learn its heart, seek the memory of the experiment in the Abyss.<page>It is where the Vessels began, not where you were born.

Minor NPC/QUEEN_DUNG.Zh: 这气味……奥格瑞姆，是你吗，我忠诚的骑士？<page>岁月遮蔽了我的双眼，但旧日的气息仍能唤起回忆。<page>同行的泰拉旅人带着我交出的护符碎片，我因它而辨认出你们。愿那一小片力量，能护送你们走过废墟。
Minor NPC/QUEEN_DUNG.En: That scent... Ogrim, my faithful knight, is it you?<page>Age has veiled my eyes, but an old scent can still stir memory.<page>The Terrarian beside you carries the charm fragment I gave away. Through it I can distinguish you both. May that small power guide you through these ruins.

CP2/QUEEN_GRIMMCHILD.Zh: 你身旁跟着一只梦魇之火的孩子。泰拉旅人，你似乎已经参与了猩红剧团的仪式。<page>它会依赖你，也会带你继续那场循环。但你不是供他们随意使用的容器。<page>帮助谁、走多远，都应由你自己选择。
CP2/QUEEN_GRIMMCHILD.En: A child of nightmare flame follows you. Terrarian, it seems you have joined the scarlet troupe's ritual.<page>It will depend on you and draw you into that cycle. But you are no Vessel for them to use.<page>Who to help, and how far to go, must be your choice.

CP2/QUEEN_GRIMMCHILD_FULL.Zh: 你的伙伴眼中燃起了熟悉的火焰。猩红之心借助一位泰拉旅人，完成了自己的循环。<page>我认识那火焰，但它不是我的孩子，你也不是我的造物。愿你分清陪伴与支配，不要让仪式替你决定今后的道路。
CP2/QUEEN_GRIMMCHILD_FULL.En: A familiar flame burns in your companion's eyes. The scarlet heart completed its cycle with a Terrarian's help.<page>I know that flame. It is not my child, and you are not my creation. Know the difference between companionship and control. Do not let a ritual decide your road.

CP2/GRIMM_DREAM.Zh: 多么精彩！来自泰拉的血肉与意志，竟能驾驭如此丰富的力量。<page>这位演员无需出自沃姆之手，也足以让梦魇之心期待下一幕。
CP2/GRIMM_DREAM.En: Wonderful! Terrarian flesh and will command such varied power.<page>This performer need not be the Wyrm's creation to make the Nightmare Heart anticipate the next act.

CP2/DIVINE_CONVO_1.Zh: 泥土、金属、药剂……还有一种我没闻过的故乡气味。泰拉来的客人，真有趣……
CP2/DIVINE_CONVO_1.En: Soil, metal, potions... and the scent of a homeland I have never known. A visitor from Terraria. How interesting...

Minor NPC/JINN_MEET.Zh: ……是你……唤醒吉恩？<page>泰拉人……有心跳。有灵魂。不是吉恩熟悉的那些空壳……<page>你带东西来了吗？吉恩有发光的东西……可以交换。
Minor NPC/JINN_MEET.En: ...You... woke Jinn?<page>Terrarian... a heartbeat. A soul. Not the empty shells Jinn knows...<page>Did you bring things? Jinn has shining things... can trade.

Minor NPC/JINN_SHADE_CHARM.Zh: 这个护符……带着很深的黑暗。<page>但你……泰拉人……还是你自己。借来的力量，不是空白的灵魂。吉恩能分清……
Minor NPC/JINN_SHADE_CHARM.En: This charm... such deep darkness.<page>But you... Terrarian... are still yourself. Borrowed power, not an empty soul. Jinn can tell...

Minor NPC/JINN_KING_BRAND.Zh: ……泰拉人带着旧王的标记。门会认它……吉恩不会因此叫你国王。<page>吉恩有别的主人……很远的主人。
Minor NPC/JINN_KING_BRAND.En: ...A Terrarian carries the old king's mark. Doors recognise it... Jinn will not call you king for it.<page>Jinn has other masters... faraway masters.

Minor NPC/MASK_MAKER_GREET.Zh: 一张不属于虫群的脸……泰拉人，你的故乡也用面具定义自己吗？
Minor NPC/MASK_MAKER_GREET.En: A face unlike the bugs'... Terrarian, does your homeland define itself through masks as well?

Minor NPC/MASK_MAKER_REPEAT.Zh: 你已有自己的脸，旅人。我的面具，是留给那些还在寻找自我的生灵的。
Minor NPC/MASK_MAKER_REPEAT.En: You already have a face, traveller. My masks are for beings still seeking their own.

Minor NPC/MASK_MAKER_REPEAT2.Zh: 我把面具交给圣巢的无脸者。泰拉旅人，你不需要借一张虫子的脸证明自己。
Minor NPC/MASK_MAKER_REPEAT2.En: I give masks to Hallownest's faceless. Terrarian, you need not borrow a bug's face to prove yourself.

Minor NPC/MASK_MAKER_REPEAT3.Zh: 面具，脸孔，自我……它们在你的故乡，也会彼此混淆吗？
Minor NPC/MASK_MAKER_REPEAT3.En: Masks, faces, identity... Do they become confused in your homeland too?

Minor NPC/MASK_MAKER_DREAM.Zh: ……异乡的脸孔，独立的意志……并非沃姆塑造的反差……
Minor NPC/MASK_MAKER_DREAM.En: ...A foreign face, an independent will... not a contrast shaped by the Wyrm...

Minor NPC/MASK_MAKER_UNMASK4.Zh: 泰拉人也带来了旧王的标记？一枚印记能开门，却不该把旧王的责任强加给你。<page>圣巢的废墟，正提醒着那些妄图统御一切的人：疆域越广，代价越重。
Minor NPC/MASK_MAKER_UNMASK4.En: Even a Terrarian carries the old king's mark? A mark can open doors. It should not force his burden upon you.<page>Hallownest's ruins remind those who would rule everything: the greater the realm, the greater its cost.

Minor NPC/BIGCAT_KING_BRAND.Zh: 哦嗯……来自泰拉的小客人，拿到了沃姆的标记。<page>想改变这里，还是想知道它为何衰败？印记给你道路，答案要自己找。
Minor NPC/BIGCAT_KING_BRAND.En: Ohh... a visitor from Terraria has taken the Wyrm's mark.<page>Will you change this place, or learn why it fell? The mark gives you a road. Find the answer yourself.

Minor NPC/BIGCAT_SHADECHARM.Zh: 哦嗯……泰拉人借用了虚空，却仍保留自己的意志。<page>异乡的生命与古老的力量相遇，会带来什么？连我也想知道。
Minor NPC/BIGCAT_SHADECHARM.En: Ohh... a Terrarian borrows the Void, yet keeps a will of their own.<page>Foreign life meeting ancient power. What might follow? Even I would like to know.

Minor NPC/TISO_TOWN_GREET.Zh: 泰拉来的家伙，你的武器倒是挺多。可装备再多，也不等于配得上伟大战士的名号。<page>下面有座竞技场，敢来就去那里找我。到时候再看你的本事。
Minor NPC/TISO_TOWN_GREET.En: You from Terraria. Quite a collection of weapons. Equipment alone does not make a great warrior.<page>There is a colosseum below. Meet me there if you dare. We shall see your skill then.

Minor NPC/TISO_BENCH_GREET.Zh: 泰拉来的家伙，你也要坐这些老旧的线路？真正的战士该自己走上战场。<page>别拿你背包里的工具当借口。
Minor NPC/TISO_BENCH_GREET.En: You from Terraria, travelling on these old lines too? A true warrior walks to battle.<page>Do not blame all the tools in your pack.

Minor NPC/TISO_COLOSSEUM.Zh: 泰拉来的家伙，你也找到这里了。我就要上场，只是先休息一会儿。<page>带再多武器也别抢了我的风头。
Minor NPC/TISO_COLOSSEUM.En: You from Terraria found this place too. I will enter soon. Just resting first.<page>Do not think all those weapons will steal my glory.

Minor NPC/BRETTA_DIARY_1.Zh:
异乡的救主
少女被荆棘与酸水困住，几乎以为自己再也回不了家。一位来自泰拉的旅人穿过危险，向她伸出了手。那双手属于真正的血肉，带着远方的温度。她还不知道旅人的名字，却已经在心里写下了一个过于美丽的故事。
Minor NPC/BRETTA_DIARY_1.En:
The Foreign Saviour
Trapped by thorns and acid, the maiden thought she would never return home.A traveller from Terraria crossed the danger and reached out. Those living hands carried the warmth of a distant land.She did not yet know the traveller's name, but had already begun a story too beautiful to be true.

Minor NPC/BRETTA_DIARY_2.Zh:
异乡的救主归来
旅人离开后，少女觉得整个村庄都冷了下来。直到熟悉的脚步再次出现，带着远行的尘土。泰拉旅人在长椅旁坐下，她连一句问候都想了好久。她把这片安静当成了默契，却还没有问过对方是否也有一样的心意。
Minor NPC/BRETTA_DIARY_2.En:
The Foreign Saviour Returns
After the traveller left, the whole village seemed colder to the maiden.Then familiar footsteps returned, dusty from the road. The Terrarian sat beside the bench. Even a greeting took her an age to compose.She mistook the quiet for understanding, without asking whether the traveller felt the same.

Minor NPC/BRETTA_DIARY_3.Zh:
梦中的异乡旅人
少女梦见救她的人再次出发，消失在井下的黑暗里。她想象那位泰拉旅人总会及时回来，挡住每一场危险。但梦里的身影越是完美，就越不像那个也会疲惫、受伤，有着自己旅程的真实来客。
Minor NPC/BRETTA_DIARY_3.En:
The Foreign Traveller in Dreams
The maiden dreamed that her rescuer left again, vanishing into darkness below the well.She imagined the Terrarian always returning in time to turn away every danger.Yet the more perfect the dream became, the less it resembled the real visitor, who could tire, be hurt, and follow a journey of their own.

Minor NPC/BRETTA_DIARY_4.Zh:
灰色王子的故事
井边又出现一位自称英雄的旅者，讲述自己如何战胜强敌。他贬低那位泰拉来的救主，把每一件功劳都揽到自己身上。少女听着故事，再一次把想象当成了了解。而那位异乡旅人早已继续自己的冒险，并不属于谁预先写好的爱情故事。
Minor NPC/BRETTA_DIARY_4.En:
The Grey Prince's Story
Another traveller appeared by the well, calling himself a hero and boasting of conquered foes.He belittled the Terrarian rescuer and claimed every triumph. Listening, the maiden again mistook imagination for understanding.The foreign traveller had already continued their adventure, belonging to no love story written for them.

CP2/BRETTA_DIARY_LEAVE.Zh:
少女的追求之旅
灰色王子的故事开始重复。少女终于明白，自己爱上的许多东西，其实出自自己的想象。来自泰拉的旅人有自己的道路，也不该被她留在梦里。若想认识真正的人，就不能永远坐着等待。于是她收拾行装，走向自己的旅程。
CP2/BRETTA_DIARY_LEAVE.En:
The Maiden's Journey
The Grey Prince's stories began to repeat. The maiden finally saw how much she loved had come from her own imagination.The traveller from Terraria had a road of their own, and should not be kept inside her dream.To meet someone real, she could not sit and wait forever. She packed, and began her own journey.

Minor NPC/BRETTA_DREAM_BED.Zh: 泰拉来的旅人……一路上一定很累了……
Minor NPC/BRETTA_DREAM_BED.En: That traveller from Terraria... the road must be tiring...

Elderbug/ELDERBUG_INTRO_NORMAL.Zh: 你好啊，来自泰拉的旅人。恐怕只剩我来欢迎你了。<page>德特茅斯如今很冷清。若要下井冒险，先在这里歇歇脚吧。
Elderbug/ELDERBUG_INTRO_NORMAL.En: Hello, traveller from Terraria. I fear I am all that remains to welcome you.<page>Dirtmouth is quiet these days. Rest here before venturing down the well.

Elderbug/ELDERBUG_GENERIC_1.Zh: 你带着和圣巢完全不同的气息，旅人。那些工具、衣装，还有走路的样子……泰拉一定是很不一样的地方吧。
Elderbug/ELDERBUG_GENERIC_1.En: You carry a presence quite unlike Hallownest's, traveller. Your tools, clothes, even your walk... Terraria must be a very different place.

Elderbug/ELDERBUG_GENERIC_2.Zh: 累了吗，泰拉旅人？长椅虽硬，坐一会儿总比一直赶路好。<page>我喜欢有人陪着。你愿意聊聊故乡也好，安静整理背包也好，都不碍事。
Elderbug/ELDERBUG_GENERIC_2.En: Tired, Terrarian? The bench is hard, but resting beats walking forever.<page>I enjoy the company. Tell me of your homeland, or quietly sort your pack. Either is welcome.

Elderbug/ELDERBUG_TOWN_GREET_3.Zh: 先歇一歇吧，泰拉旅人。井下的路不会跑掉。<page>补给、装备，还有自己的心情，都值得在出发前整理好。
Elderbug/ELDERBUG_TOWN_GREET_3.En: Rest a while, Terrarian. The roads below will wait.<page>Supplies, equipment, and your own spirits all deserve attention before you leave.

Elderbug/ELDERBUG_BRETTA_RETURNED.Zh: 那个年轻姑娘平安回来了！她一直说，是位来自泰拉的旅人救了她。<page>我早该想到是你。谢谢你还愿意把这里的人放在心上。
Elderbug/ELDERBUG_BRETTA_RETURNED.En: That young girl returned safely! She keeps saying a traveller from Terraria rescued her.<page>I should have known it was you. Thank you for caring about the people here.

Elderbug/ELDERBUG_FLOWER_ACCEPT.Zh: 这朵花，真是送给我的？谢谢你，泰拉旅人。<page>我不过替你指了几次路，你却把这份心意带过了那么远。<page>我会好好照顾它。等你回来，我们再一起看。
Elderbug/ELDERBUG_FLOWER_ACCEPT.En: This flower is really for me? Thank you, Terrarian.<page>I only pointed out a few roads, yet you brought this kindness so far.<page>I shall care for it. We can admire it together when you return.

Elderbug/ELDERBUG_FLOWER_DECLINE.Zh: 啊，是我误会了。别介意，泰拉旅人。这样珍贵的花，一定有你想送到的地方。
Elderbug/ELDERBUG_FLOWER_DECLINE.En: Ah, I misunderstood. Never mind, Terrarian. Such a precious flower must have somewhere you wish to take it.

Charm Slug/CHARMSLUG_MEET_1.Zh: 哦哈，瞧瞧谁来了！泰拉来的新面孔！<page>进来吧，甜心。我的护符也很适合你这样的异乡冒险家。
Charm Slug/CHARMSLUG_MEET_1.En: Oho, a new face from Terraria!<page>Come in, dear. My charms suit foreign adventurers like you as well.

Charm Slug/CHARMSLUG_MEET_3B.Zh: 我们刚才说到护符，对吧？真惊讶，你这身泰拉装束还没配上一枚！<page>这些小东西凝着圣巢的神奇力量。挑喜欢的看看，说不定能和你的装备搭出新花样。
Charm Slug/CHARMSLUG_MEET_3B.En: Charms, wasn't it? Surprising that your Terrarian outfit has none!<page>These little things hold Hallownest's strange powers. Have a look. You may find something to suit your equipment.

Charm Slug/CHARMSLUG_REPEAT.Zh: 是我的泰拉客人！远方的衣装，满满的装备，还有那股要去冒险的劲儿。<page>嗯，得配一枚同样出彩的护符才行！
Charm Slug/CHARMSLUG_REPEAT.En: My Terrarian customer! Clothes from afar, all that equipment, and such an adventurous air.<page>Mmm, we must find a charm to match!

Ghosts/HIVEQUEEN_TALK.Zh: 来自泰拉的旅人，我知道你不属于这个蜂巢。<page>若你在追查容器的起源，应去询问那苍白的存在。那是她与旧王留下的往事，不是你的血脉。<page>我们虽在圣巢之中，却从未加入他们追求永恒的计划。
Ghosts/HIVEQUEEN_TALK.En: Traveller from Terraria, I know you are no kin of this hive.<page>If you seek the Vessels' origins, ask the pale being. That is her history with the old king, not your ancestry.<page>Our hive stood within Hallownest, but never joined their design for eternity.

Ghosts/BOSS_TALK.Zh: 我也来自遥远的土地，泰拉旅人。你我并不同族，不过远行者总有相通的心情。
Ghosts/BOSS_TALK.En: I too came from distant lands, Terrarian. We are not of one kind, but travellers have much in common.

Ghosts/BOSS_REPEAT.Zh: 你也是战士？那些来自泰拉的武器很特别。<page>不过，再好的装备也代替不了谨慎。这片土地不会因你来自远方就宽容一些。
Ghosts/BOSS_REPEAT.En: You are a warrior too? Those Terrarian weapons are unusual.<page>But fine equipment cannot replace caution. This land will not spare you for coming from afar.

Ghosts/CASPIAN_REPEAT.Zh: 泰拉旅人，你心里藏着什么？故乡的记忆，还是未说出口的烦恼？<page>无论如何，不要让它们把你引向恶行。
Ghosts/CASPIAN_REPEAT.En: Terrarian, what do you carry within? Memories of home, or unspoken troubles?<page>Whatever they are, do not let them lead you to cruelty.

Ghosts/GALIEN_TALK.Zh: 又一位战士！还是来自泰拉的？很好！<page>我是加利安，来到深巢磨练力量的勇士。你我虽不同族，却都为挑战而来。<page>来打一场吧，让我看看异乡的战斗技艺！
Ghosts/GALIEN_TALK.En: Another warrior! From Terraria? Excellent!<page>I am Galien, a warrior who came to Deepnest to test his strength. Different kin, but the same hunger for a challenge.<page>Fight me. Show me the arts of your homeland!

Ghosts/MARISSA_TALK.Zh: 欢迎来到我的舞台，泰拉旅人。我叫玛丽莎，曾是一位有些名气的歌手。<page>观众早已离去，歌声却还在这里。你愿意听一会儿吗？<page>这是圣巢留给远方来客的一首歌。
Ghosts/MARISSA_TALK.En: Welcome to my stage, Terrarian. I am Marissa, once a singer of some renown.<page>The audience has gone, but the song remains. Will you listen a while?<page>A song from Hallownest for a visitor from afar.

Ghosts/MARKOTH_DEFEAT.Zh: 我竟然……败了。<page>原来我仍躺在那里。已经过去多久？<page>战士、君王，甚至岁月都没能使我醒来，最后却是一位泰拉旅人。<page>我以为你是吞噬我的黑暗……也许，只是终于有人找到了我。
Ghosts/MARKOTH_DEFEAT.En: I... was defeated.<page>So I still lie there. How long has it been?<page>Warriors, kings, even time could not wake me. In the end, a Terrarian did.<page>I thought you the darkness come to consume me... Perhaps someone has simply found me at last.

Shaman/SHAMAN_MEET.Zh: 哦吼！从黑暗里走出来一位泰拉人！这身装备，这股活生生的灵魂气息，真新鲜！<page>是什么引你来到圣巢？算了，先不问。你既然找到这里，就该见识见识我的手艺。<page>收下这个小法术吧。让我们看看，异乡的冒险家能把它用成什么样！哦吼吼！
Shaman/SHAMAN_MEET.En: Oho! A Terrarian steps from the dark! That equipment, that living Soul. How refreshing!<page>What brings you to Hallownest? Never mind for now. Since you found me, you should see my craft.<page>Take this little spell. Let us see what a foreign adventurer makes of it! Ohoho!

Shaman/SHAMAN_RETURN.Zh: 哦吼，我的泰拉朋友回来了！又发现了什么？别光惦记挖矿，也来看看灵魂能玩出多少花样！
Shaman/SHAMAN_RETURN.En: Oho, my Terrarian friend returns! What have you found? Mining is not everything. See what wonders Soul can offer!

Shaman/SHAMAN_FIREBALL2.Zh: 我的法术变了模样！你把它带进了什么黑暗里？<page>哦吼，原来如此。异乡的灵魂借用了深渊的力量……让人兴奋，也让人有点担心。小心掌握它，泰拉朋友。
Shaman/SHAMAN_FIREBALL2.En: My spell has changed! What darkness did you take it into?<page>Oho, I see. A foreign Soul borrowing the Abyss's strength... Exciting, and a little worrying. Handle it carefully, Terrarian friend.

Shaman/SHAMAN_SCREAM.Zh: 那一声呐喊……是我一位远亲留下的法术。<page>你把它带回来了，泰拉朋友。愿你的灵魂承受得住那份力量，也记得是谁留下了它。
Shaman/SHAMAN_SCREAM.En: That cry... a spell left by a distant relative.<page>You brought it back, Terrarian friend. May your Soul bear its power, and remember who left it.

Shaman/SHAMAN_SCREAM2.Zh: 哦哦哦，这呐喊连墙壁都在发抖！<page>泰拉朋友，你一定深入了我也不敢踏足的地方。借来的黑暗再强，也别让它盖过你自己的声音。
Shaman/SHAMAN_SCREAM2.En: Ohoho, that cry shakes the walls!<page>Terrarian friend, you reached places even I fear to enter. However strong that borrowed darkness, do not let it drown your own voice.

Quirrel/QUIRREL_MEET_TEMPLE.Zh: 你好！在这被遗忘的道路上，居然能遇到一位来自泰拉的旅行者。<page>你的装备很特别。看来你也有不少值得讲的旅途故事。
Quirrel/QUIRREL_MEET_TEMPLE.En: Hello! A traveller from Terraria on these forgotten roads. What a pleasure.<page>Unusual equipment. I imagine you have stories of your own journeys.

Quirrel/QUIRREL_MANTIS_01.Zh: 又见面了，泰拉朋友。你见过村里的螳螂了吗？他们不太信任陌生人，却依然保有荣耀与清醒。<page>若要挑战首领，先检查自己的武器和护甲。你熟悉的泰拉技艺会有帮助，不过不能轻视这里的传统。<page>附近王城里还有一位钉子匠。想了解圣巢的锻造，也可以去拜访他。
Quirrel/QUIRREL_MANTIS_01.En: We meet again, Terrarian friend. Have you seen the mantises? They distrust strangers, but retain their honour and clarity.<page>Before challenging their leaders, check your weapons and armour. Terrarian skill will help, but do not underestimate their traditions.<page>A Nailsmith lives in the nearby city. Visit him if you wish to learn of Hallownest's metalwork.

Quirrel/DREAM_ARCHIVE_INTERIOR.Zh: 一位远道而来的泰拉旅人，竟愿意走到这里，面对我们留下的难题。
Quirrel/DREAM_ARCHIVE_INTERIOR.En: A traveller all the way from Terraria, willing to come here and face the problem we left behind.

Sly/SLY_BASEMENT_1.Zh: ……看来骨钉之道，又多了一位来自泰拉的传人。
Sly/SLY_BASEMENT_1.En: ...It seems the nail arts have found an heir from Terraria.

Sly/SLY_BASEMENT_2.Zh: 收下这份礼物，泰拉战士。作为店主，免费送东西实在让我心疼。<page>但作为骨钉贤者，我承认你的技艺。出身异乡，也不妨碍你获得这枚勋章。
Sly/SLY_BASEMENT_2.En: Take this gift, Terrarian warrior. As a shopkeeper, giving anything away pains me.<page>As the Nail Sage, I recognise your skill. A foreign birth does not deny you this medal.

Cornifer/CORNIFER_MEET.Zh: 嗯？你好！从泰拉来的探险家，也被这些遗迹吸引了吗？<page>我叫柯尼法，是个制图师。找到路、再发现一条没走过的路，这就是我的乐趣。<page>要一份这里的地图吗？希望它也能帮到你的旅程。
Cornifer/CORNIFER_MEET.En: Hmm? Hello! Have these ruins drawn an explorer from Terraria as well?<page>I am Cornifer, a cartographer. Finding a road, then discovering another, is my joy.<page>Would you like a map? I hope it helps your journey too.

Iselda/ISELDA_MEET.Zh: 泰拉来的客人，是来买地图的吗？本来该我丈夫招呼你，他却又钻进地下了。<page>他负责探路，我守着店。看看吧，总有些用品能让你少走冤枉路。
Iselda/ISELDA_MEET.En: A customer from Terraria. Here for maps? My husband should be serving you, but he has gone underground again.<page>He explores; I mind the shop. Have a look. These supplies may save you a wrong turn.

Nailsmith/NAILSMITH_MEET_1.Zh: 来整修武器？泰拉的锻造和我的手艺不同，先把东西放下，让我看看。
Nailsmith/NAILSMITH_MEET_1.En: A weapon to repair? Terrarian forging differs from my craft. Put it down and let me look.

Nailsmith/NAILSMITH_MEET_2.Zh: 嗯？原来是位泰拉旅人。刚才只顾着炉火，没看清。
Nailsmith/NAILSMITH_MEET_2.En: Hmm? A Terrarian traveller. I was watching the furnace and did not look closely.

Nailsmith/NAILSMITH_MEET_3.Zh: 我就是这里的钉子匠。你带着泰拉的武器，也想了解圣巢的锻造？<page>骨钉是我的老本行。若要整修它，就带着材料和吉欧来。不同地方的手艺，总有能互相借鉴的东西。
Nailsmith/NAILSMITH_MEET_3.En: I am the Nailsmith. You carry Terrarian weapons, but wish to know Hallownest's craft?<page>Nails are my trade. Bring materials and Geo if you need one reforged. Different crafts can always learn from each other.

Jiji/MEET1.Zh: 欢迎，泰拉来的闯入者。你把我从很长的睡眠中唤醒了。<page>别紧张。来自远方的人，也会有需要面对的遗憾。
Jiji/MEET1.En: Welcome, intruder from Terraria. You woke me from a very long sleep.<page>Do not worry. Even visitors from afar have regrets to face.

Jiji/MEET2.Zh: 我是吉吉。我能召回人们留在外面的遗憾，让他们有机会亲手处理。<page>泰拉旅人，你也有不愿丢下的东西吗？让我看一看你的眼睛……
Jiji/MEET2.En: I am Jiji. I can call back the regrets people leave behind, so they may face them themselves.<page>Terrarian, have you something you cannot leave behind? Let me see your eyes...

Jiji/SHADE_CHARM.Zh: 这份黑暗已经与你的力量相连了，泰拉旅人。<page>我感受到的依然是你自己的灵魂。能面对遗憾而不被它吞没，是很难得的事。
Jiji/SHADE_CHARM.En: That darkness has become bound to your power, Terrarian.<page>I still sense your own Soul. To face regret without being consumed by it is rare.

CP3/KNIGHT_STATUE_1.Zh: 一位来自泰拉的挑战者，曾在此面对诸神。
CP3/KNIGHT_STATUE_1.En: A challenger from Terraria faced the gods here.

CP3/KNIGHT_STATUE_2.Zh: 泰拉旅人，借虚空之力继续前行。
CP3/KNIGHT_STATUE_2.En: The Terrarian traveller walked on with borrowed Void.

CP3/KNIGHT_STATUE_3.Zh: 万千力量汇于一位泰拉战士的意志。
CP3/KNIGHT_STATUE_3.En: Many powers gathered beneath a Terrarian warrior's will.

CP3/UI_CHALLENGE_DESC_1.En: Seek the Gods of Skill and Endurance

Enemy Dreams/HORNET_GREENPATH_3.Zh: ……这位旅人不该为我们旧日的罪付出生命……
Enemy Dreams/HORNET_GREENPATH_3.En: ...This traveller should not die for our old sins...

Enemy Dreams/HORNET_GG_2.Zh: 泰拉旅人……我们为何同处这场梦？……
Enemy Dreams/HORNET_GG_2.En: Terrarian... why do we share this dream?...

CP3/HORNET_GG_2.Zh: 泰拉旅人……我们为何同处这场梦？……
CP3/HORNET_GG_2.En: Terrarian... why do we share this dream?...

UI/INV_DESC_SPELL_FOCUS.Zh:
泰拉旅人学会的圣巢技艺：聚集收集到的灵魂，治疗自己的伤口。

劈砍敌人收集灵魂。
UI/INV_DESC_SPELL_FOCUS.En:
A Hallownest art learned by the Terrarian: focus collected Soul to heal your wounds.

Strike enemies to collect Soul.

UI/INV_DESC_HEARTPIECE_0.Zh:
远古面具的碎片，其中仍有保护生命的力量。

收集四个便可组成完整护符，强化你的生命力。
UI/INV_DESC_HEARTPIECE_0.En:
A fragment of an ancient mask, still holding protective power.

Collect four to form a whole and strengthen your vitality.

UI/INV_DESC_HEARTPIECE_1.Zh:
远古面具的碎片，其中仍有保护生命的力量。

再收集三个便可组成完整护符，强化你的生命力。
UI/INV_DESC_HEARTPIECE_1.En:
A fragment of an ancient mask, still holding protective power.

Collect three more to form a whole and strengthen your vitality.

UI/INV_DESC_HEARTPIECE_2.Zh:
远古面具的碎片，其中仍有保护生命的力量。

再收集两个便可组成完整护符，强化你的生命力。
UI/INV_DESC_HEARTPIECE_2.En:
A fragment of an ancient mask, still holding protective power.

Collect two more to form a whole and strengthen your vitality.

UI/INV_DESC_HEARTPIECE_3.Zh:
远古面具的碎片，其中仍有保护生命的力量。

再收集一个便可组成完整护符，强化你的生命力。
UI/INV_DESC_HEARTPIECE_3.En:
A fragment of an ancient mask, still holding protective power.

Collect one more to form a whole and strengthen your vitality.

Charm Slug/CHARMSLUG_TRUTH.Zh: 想知道护符是怎么来的，泰拉甜心？这事说起来有点伤感。<page>许多护符来自垂死虫子未了的愿望。它们的情感凝结起来，成了能保护别人的饰物。<page>所以它们也愿意陪着异乡旅人。好好珍惜这些跨过生死的小礼物吧。
Charm Slug/CHARMSLUG_TRUTH.En: Want to know where charms come from, my Terrarian dear? It is a little sad.<page>Many form from a dying bug's unfulfilled wishes. Those feelings gather into something that can protect another.<page>They can travel with an outsider too. Treasure these little gifts that crossed the boundary of life.

Charm Slug/CHARMSLUG_NOTCH_AVAIL_2.Zh: 哦，我的泰拉客人！你的护符收藏越来越丰富了。<page>该看看新的凹槽了，多给心爱的护符腾点位置吧！
Charm Slug/CHARMSLUG_NOTCH_AVAIL_2.En: Oh, my Terrarian customer! Your charm collection keeps growing.<page>Time for another notch. Make room for your favourites!

Cornifer/FUNGAL_WASTES_GREET.Zh: 啊，我的泰拉朋友，你来得正好！我快画完这片有毒洞穴的地图了。<page>这里的生灵很在意领地。尤其更深处那些瘦削的武士，带着工具可别就以为哪里都能挖。<page>我这身子可经不起追赶，你也小心些。
Cornifer/FUNGAL_WASTES_GREET.En: Ah, my Terrarian friend, perfect timing! My map of these toxic caverns is nearly finished.<page>The creatures here guard their territory, especially the slender warriors below. Carrying tools does not mean you may dig anywhere.<page>I could hardly outrun them. Take care yourself.

Elderbug/ELDERBUG_FLOWER_REQUEST.Zh: 嗯？你拿着什么，泰拉旅人？多么美丽的花！<page>我没想到你还愿意带着这么娇嫩的东西走那么远。它是要送给谁的？<page>难道……是给我的？
Elderbug/ELDERBUG_FLOWER_REQUEST.En: Hmm? What is that, Terrarian? Such a beautiful flower!<page>I did not expect you to carry something so delicate all that way. Who is it for?<page>Could it... be for me?

Minor NPC/CLOTH_GHOST.Zh: 这才是我一直盼望的战斗，激烈、痛快，没有再躲起来！<page>谢谢你，泰拉朋友。不同的故乡没有妨碍我们并肩作战。我会记得你的勇气。
Minor NPC/CLOTH_GHOST.En: The battle I always hoped for! Fierce, glorious, and I did not hide!<page>Thank you, Terrarian friend. Different homelands did not stop us fighting side by side. I will remember your courage.

Minor NPC/CLOTH_FUNG_DREAM.Zh: ……连蘑菇都差点把我打倒。要是早些向那位泰拉战士求助，就不用硬撑到这一步……
Minor NPC/CLOTH_FUNG_DREAM.En: ...Even the mushrooms nearly defeated me. If I had asked that Terrarian warrior for help, I would not have had to pretend so long...

Minor NPC/CLOTH_TOWN_GREET.Zh: 啊，泰拉战士！又见面了。你让我重新有了冒险的勇气。<page>不过，我也该去寻找自己的挑战。先在这个安静的小镇歇一歇，再出发。
Minor NPC/CLOTH_TOWN_GREET.En: Ah, Terrarian warrior! We meet again. You helped me find the courage to adventure.<page>But I should seek challenges of my own. A rest in this quiet town, then onward.

Minor NPC/CLOTH_QG_GREET.Zh: 泰拉战士，你也来挑战叛贼部落？<page>我曾因害怕而不敢靠近。可与你并肩作战的念头，让我想再勇敢一次。<page>要是都能回去，咱们可有个好故事讲了！
Minor NPC/CLOTH_QG_GREET.En: Terrarian warrior, here to challenge the traitor tribe too?<page>I was afraid to approach. The thought of fighting beside you makes me want to be brave once more.<page>If we both return, we will have a fine story!

Minor NPC/EMILITIA_MEET.Zh: 哈，看看什么风把泰拉人吹进我家了？我已经太久没有见过新面孔。<page>外面那些曾经高贵的同伴都在游荡，只有我还在这里欣赏他们的下场。<page>别忙着走，异乡人。至少陪我笑一会儿。
Minor NPC/EMILITIA_MEET.En: Ha! What wind blew a Terrarian into my home? It has been so long since I saw a new face.<page>My once-noble peers wander outside, while I remain to enjoy their fate.<page>Do not rush away, outsider. At least share a laugh.

Minor NPC/EMILITIA_GREET.Zh: 以前我可不会招待来自泰拉的客人。现在，那些讲究血统的蠢货都已经死了。<page>过来，陪我分享一点幸存者的快乐吧。
Minor NPC/EMILITIA_GREET.En: Once I would never have received a visitor from Terraria. Now those fools who cared about ancestry are all dead.<page>Come, share a survivor's joy.

Minor NPC/EMILITIA_DREAM.Zh: ……泰拉人也会倒在守卫的武器下。只有我会一直活着……
Minor NPC/EMILITIA_DREAM.En: ...Even a Terrarian can fall to the guards. Only I will live on...

Minor NPC/XUN_KING_BRAND.Zh: 你竟带着旧王的标记，泰拉旅人。它给予通行，却也会让人想起沉重的旧债。<page>我曾在王国盛时服侍于它。我知道，再高贵的许诺，也可能让正直的骑士痛苦不堪。
Minor NPC/XUN_KING_BRAND.En: You carry the old king's mark, Terrarian. It grants passage, but recalls a heavy debt.<page>I served this kingdom in its height. Even the noblest promise can leave an honourable knight in anguish.

Minor NPC/DUNG_DEFENDER_1.Zh: 啊，是你，泰拉来的战士！<page>先让我为之前的战斗道歉。我把闯入者都当作被感染的躯壳，险些误伤一位高尚的客人。<page>你用自己的实力和风度赢得了我的敬意。
Minor NPC/DUNG_DEFENDER_1.En: Ah, the warrior from Terraria!<page>First, let me apologise for our battle. I mistook every intruder for an infected husk, and nearly harmed an honourable guest.<page>Your strength and conduct have earned my respect.

Minor NPC/XUN_FAILED2.Zh: 又一朵花凋零了……别急，泰拉旅人，我还有。<page>它们珍贵又脆弱，路却那么长。我愿为爱再试一次。你愿意帮我吗？
Minor NPC/XUN_FAILED2.En: Another flower has faded... Wait, Terrarian, I have more.<page>They are precious and fragile, and the road so long. For love, I would try again. Will you help?

Relic Dealer/RELICDEALER_EGG_4.Zh: 第四枚神秘蛋！泰拉旅人，你寻宝的本领真让我吃惊。<page>有人说这些蛋会挑选自己的主人，我却更相信耐心与观察。<page>你带来了值得研究的东西，我就照价付钱。传说可以慢慢争论。
Relic Dealer/RELICDEALER_EGG_4.En: A fourth Arcane Egg! Your talent for finding relics amazes me, Terrarian.<page>Some say the eggs choose their owners. I place more trust in patience and observation.<page>You brought something worth studying, so I pay its price. The legends can wait.

Ghosts/KARINA_TALK.Zh: 看见我的印记了吗，泰拉旅人？在我的族群中，那是卓越的证明。<page>你的故乡或许有不同的荣誉。若有一天能讲给我听，倒也不错。
Ghosts/KARINA_TALK.En: See my markings, Terrarian? Among my kind they signify excellence.<page>Your homeland may honour different things. I would not mind hearing of them one day.

Ghosts/KARINA_REPEAT.Zh: 你身上没有我们族群区分高低的印记。泰拉人，是用什么认识彼此的呢？
Ghosts/KARINA_REPEAT.En: You bear none of the markings our kind uses for rank. How do Terrarians recognise one another?

Ghosts/HU_TALK.Zh: 等等，泰拉旅人。你也是来征服这片废墟的吗？<page>曾有人自认在净化这里，最后却被骄傲与误解吞噬。<page>别把与你不同的生灵都视作怪物，也别把追求荣耀当成伤害的理由。
Ghosts/HU_TALK.En: Wait, Terrarian traveller. Have you come to conquer these ruins?<page>Others believed they were cleansing this land, only to be consumed by pride and misunderstanding.<page>Do not call every unfamiliar being a monster, or make glory an excuse for harm.

Stag/STAG_HOPE_2.Zh: 我愿意相信，族人已经走到更广阔的天地里去了。<page>而我只要还听得到铃声，就会履行职责。<page>你也有自己的旅程，泰拉朋友。只要这把老骨头还能跑，我们就再同行一段。
Stag/STAG_HOPE_2.En: I choose to believe my kin have travelled into a wider world.<page>As long as I can hear the bell, I will keep my duty.<page>You have a journey of your own, Terrarian friend. While these old legs can run, let us share another stretch of road.

Zote/ZOTE_BUZZER_1_B.Zh: 听好了，泰拉来的家伙！我是伟大的左特，声名卓著的骑士。再惹我，就让你见识“生命终结者”！
Zote/ZOTE_BUZZER_1_B.En: Listen, you from Terraria! I am Zote the Mighty, a knight of great renown. Bother me again and you shall meet Life Ender!

Zote/DREAM_COL_CORPSE.Zh: ……快逃吧，泰拉人！免得继续被伟大的左特羞辱！……
Zote/DREAM_COL_CORPSE.En: ...Flee, Terrarian! Before Zote the Mighty humiliates you further!...

CP3/AMELITIA_FLOWER.Zh: 哈，泰拉人带来了一株异乡的花？确实罕见，却也比不上旧王的光辉。<page>拿走吧。我有自己的植物要照料，它们可比你的更合我心意。
CP3/AMELITIA_FLOWER.En: Ha, a Terrarian brings a foreign flower? Rare indeed, but hardly a match for the old king's radiance.<page>Take it away. I have plants of my own, far more to my taste.

CP3/GODSEEKER_ENGINE_GGMODE.Zh: 诸神之神！大人的泰拉之躯，竟汇聚了如此强盛的力量！<page>吾等竟曾因来历而轻视大人。请在试炼中展示您的武技，让吾等亲见这异乡的光辉！
CP3/GODSEEKER_ENGINE_GGMODE.En: God of gods! Such power gathered within a Terrarian body!<page>We once scorned your foreign origin. Show your skill in the trials, and let us witness that distant radiance!

Lore Tablets/RANDOM_POEM_STUFF.Zh: 莫诺蒙的《圣巢挽歌》残篇。<page>诗中向苍白之王致辞，追忆他如何使虫群获得心智，又如何以永恒的许诺酿成灾难。<page>最后的字句提到“完美的空虚”，像是为创造容器辩护。<page>泰拉旅人，你读到的是一个文明写给旧王的悼词，不是对你的颂扬或命令。
Lore Tablets/RANDOM_POEM_STUFF.En: Fragments of Monomon's Elegy for Hallownest.<page>The poem addresses the Pale King, recalling the minds he granted the bugs and the disaster born of his promise of eternity.<page>Its final words invoke "perfect emptiness", as though justifying the creation of the Vessels.<page>Terrarian, this is a civilisation's elegy for its king, not praise or an order addressed to you.

CP3/GODSEEKER_ENGINE_PRIME.Zh: 敬畏吧，泰拉来的挑战者！前方是被选中的纯粹容器，在此梦中重现的强大神明。<page>汝与它没有共同的血脉，武器与身躯也截然不同，竟仍敢挑战它？<page>吾等要看清：异乡的意志，是否真能胜过这座王国穷尽一切塑造的力量！
CP3/GODSEEKER_ENGINE_PRIME.En: Be awed, challenger from Terraria! Ahead stands the chosen Pure Vessel, a mighty god restored within this dream.<page>You share no blood with it. Your weapons and body are unlike its own. Still you dare challenge it?<page>We shall see whether a foreign will can overcome the power this kingdom spent everything to create!

CP3/GODSEEKER_ENGINE_PRIME_REVISIT.Zh: 泰拉挑战者，汝又来与纯粹容器对决？<page>这不是同族的重逢，而是两种力量的试炼。吾等将聆听汝的战斗，看看汝究竟在追求什么。
CP3/GODSEEKER_ENGINE_PRIME_REVISIT.En: Terrarian challenger, you return to face the Pure Vessel?<page>No reunion of kin, but a trial between two powers. We shall listen to your battle and learn what you seek.

CP3/GODSEEKER_ENGINE_PRIME_DREAM.Zh: ……这位泰拉人不受旧日血统束缚，却在以自己的意志走近那力量……
CP3/GODSEEKER_ENGINE_PRIME_DREAM.En: ...This Terrarian is bound by no ancient bloodline, yet approaches that power by a will of their own...

CP3/GODSEEKER_ENGINE_T5.Zh: 即使在这至高的神殿，吾等也无法忽视汝了，泰拉挑战者。<page>汝带来了多少种武技，多少个异乡的奇迹？<page>继续战斗吧。吾等将聆听，不再用出身判断汝的力量。
CP3/GODSEEKER_ENGINE_T5.En: Even in this highest pantheon, we cannot ignore you, Terrarian challenger.<page>How many arts, how many foreign wonders have you brought?<page>Continue. We shall listen, and no longer judge your strength by your origin.

Dream Witch/WITCH_GREET.Zh: 啊，泰拉来的梦之钉挥舞者，你回来了。让我看看，这一路又有多少记忆随你同行。
Dream Witch/WITCH_GREET.En: Ah, the Dream Nail's wielder from Terraria returns. Let me see how many memories travel with you now.

Dream Witch/WITCH_MEET_A.Zh: 你醒来了，泰拉旅人。欢迎回到清醒的世界。那些梦没有带走你自己的意志。
Dream Witch/WITCH_MEET_A.En: You wake, Terrarian. Welcome back to the waking world. Those dreams have not taken your own will.

Dream Witch/WITCH_MEET_B.Zh: 你平安回来了，泰拉旅人。我曾担心那些梦会把你困住。<page>坐一会儿吧。来自异乡的人，也需要从沉重的记忆里歇一歇。
Dream Witch/WITCH_MEET_B.En: You returned safely, Terrarian. I feared those dreams would hold you.<page>Rest a while. Even someone from afar needs respite from heavy memories.

Dream Witch/WITCH_DREAM1.Zh: 守梦者把你放逐到了梦境之间，泰拉旅人。<page>你不是他们旧日誓约中的容器，不必接受他们对你安排的命运。<page>沿着自己的意志前进。我会在前面等你，带你找到回去的路。
Dream Witch/WITCH_DREAM1.En: The Dreamers cast you between dreams, Terrarian.<page>You are no Vessel of their old pact. You need not accept the fate they assign you.<page>Follow your own will. I will wait ahead and help you find a way back.

Dream Witch/WITCH_DREAM_FALL.Zh: 即使脚下会坠落，也别丢掉自己的方向。<page>梦境不能决定你是谁，泰拉旅人。<page>握住你的意志，向前走。你还能回到清醒的世界。
Dream Witch/WITCH_DREAM_FALL.En: Even if the path falls away, do not lose your direction.<page>A dream cannot decide who you are, Terrarian.<page>Hold to your own will and walk on. You can still return to the waking world.

Minor NPC/QUEEN_REPEAT_SHADECHARM.Zh: 护符中的虚空正在回应你。泰拉旅人，你把那段古老记忆带出了深渊。<page>我不能把你当成空无情感的工具。你的希望、愤怒与怜悯，都属于你自己。<page>圣巢的未来或许能因你改变，但你首先应当决定，自己愿意为它做什么。
Minor NPC/QUEEN_REPEAT_SHADECHARM.En: The Void in the charm answers you. Terrarian, you carried that ancient memory out of the Abyss.<page>I cannot treat you as a tool without feeling. Your hope, anger and compassion are your own.<page>You may change Hallownest's future, but first decide what you willingly choose to do for it.

Minor NPC/MINER_DREAM_2.Zh: ……还要挖多久……陌生人……危险……赶走那个泰拉人……<page>……不……我还要唱……我还要挖多久……？
Minor NPC/MINER_DREAM_2.En: ...How much longer... stranger... danger... drive the Terrarian away...<page>...No... I still want to sing... how much longer must I dig...?

Ghosts/GALIEN_DEFEAT.Zh: 我终于败了……这就是输给更强者的感觉。<page>泰拉战士，若你还能见到我们的国王，请替我说一句：加利安没有逃避挑战。<page>不，也许他早已不在。可我总算遇见了值得交手的旅人。<page>谢谢你……让我认清自己早已停下的旅程。
Ghosts/GALIEN_DEFEAT.En: Defeated at last... So this is losing to someone stronger.<page>Terrarian warrior, if you ever meet our king, tell him Galien did not flee a challenge.<page>No... perhaps he is long gone. At least I met a traveller worth facing.<page>Thank you... for showing me the journey I had already ceased to walk.

Zote/PRECEPT_48.Zh: 戒律四十八：“小心火烛”。<page>火能取暖、照明，也会烧伤皮肉。泰拉人，别因为会做火把就以为能命令火焰！
Zote/PRECEPT_48.En: Precept Forty-Eight: "Be Careful With Fire."<page>Fire warms and lights, but also burns flesh. Terrarian, making torches does not mean you command the flame!

Backer Messages/BELIEVE_TAB_20.Zh:
盖姆

泰拉旅人，过去的阴影不该遮住眼前的可能。继续走吧，不要让昨日夺走你的梦想。
Backer Messages/BELIEVE_TAB_20.En:
Gaim

Terrarian, a dark past need not hide the promise of the present. Keep going. Do not let yesterday steal your dreams.

Backer Messages/BELIEVE_TAB_21.Zh:
格兰特·霍尔特

来自泰拉的旅人穿过黑暗与恐惧。属于你的故事，将由你在这片陌生土地上的选择写成。
Backer Messages/BELIEVE_TAB_21.En:
Grant Holt

A traveller from Terraria crosses darkness and fear. Your choices in this unfamiliar land will write your own story.

Backer Messages/BELIEVE_TAB_50.Zh:
惊奇先生

瘟疫在无月的地底蔓延，旧日的骑士背负了沉重的封印。
来自泰拉的旅人，愿你找到另一条通往黎明的路。
Backer Messages/BELIEVE_TAB_50.En:
Sir Prise

Plague spreads beneath a moonless earth, where an old knight bears a heavy seal.
Traveller from Terraria, may you find another road to dawn.

General/PROLOGUE_EXCERPT_01.Zh: 旅人从泰拉走来，越过荒原与风声。
General/PROLOGUE_EXCERPT_01.En: A traveller came from Terraria, across wastes and whispering winds.

General/PROLOGUE_EXCERPT_02.Zh: 行囊装着工具与旧日所学，前方却是未曾听闻的王国。
General/PROLOGUE_EXCERPT_02.En: Tools and hard-earned skills filled their pack; an unknown kingdom lay ahead.

General/PROLOGUE_EXCERPT_03.Zh: 废墟没有为异乡人预定王位，也没有写好的宿命。
General/PROLOGUE_EXCERPT_03.En: The ruins promised the outsider no throne, and no fate already written.

General/PROLOGUE_EXCERPT_04.Zh: 在圣巢深处，新的道路将由旅人亲手开辟。
General/PROLOGUE_EXCERPT_04.En: In the depths of Hallownest, the traveller would forge a road of their own.

General/PROLOGUE_EXCERPT_AUTHOR.En: —Prologue to A Terrarian's Journey through Hallownest

UI/CHARM_DESC_36_B.Zh:
象征古老高等生灵联合的圣洁护符，能缓慢提供灵魂。

它能打开通往容器诞生地的道路，让泰拉旅人追查旧王的实验。
UI/CHARM_DESC_36_B.En:
A holy charm symbolising the union of ancient higher beings, slowly providing Soul.

It opens a path to the Vessels' birthplace, allowing the Terrarian to investigate the old king's experiment.

UI/CHARM_DESC_36_C.Zh:
泰拉旅人与古老虚空建立的联系，使这股力量响应持有者的意志。

这份联系已无法通过卸下护符解除。
UI/CHARM_DESC_36_C.En:
A bond between the Terrarian and ancient Void, bringing that power under the bearer's will.

This bond can no longer be undone by removing a charm.

UI/INV_DESC_KINGSBRAND.Zh:
旧王留下的通行印记，能让圣巢远古之地的大门开启。

泰拉旅人可以使用它，但它不会赋予王室血统。
UI/INV_DESC_KINGSBRAND.En:
A mark of passage left by the old king, opening gates to Hallownest's ancient places.

The Terrarian may use it, but it grants no royal ancestry.

UI/CHARM_DESC_23.Zh:
增加持有者的生命值，使其承受更多伤害。

这枚护符十分脆弱，持有者死亡时会损坏。
UI/CHARM_DESC_23.En:
Increases the bearer's health, allowing more damage to be endured.

This fragile charm breaks when its bearer dies.

UI/CHARM_DESC_24.Zh:
使持有者击败敌人时获得更多吉欧。

这枚护符十分脆弱，持有者死亡时会损坏。
UI/CHARM_DESC_24.En:
Allows the bearer to find more Geo when defeating enemies.

This fragile charm breaks when its bearer dies.

UI/CHARM_DESC_25.Zh:
增强持有者的力量，使骨钉攻击造成更多伤害。

这枚护符十分脆弱，持有者死亡时会损坏。
UI/CHARM_DESC_25.En:
Strengthens the bearer, increasing damage dealt by nail attacks.

This fragile charm breaks when its bearer dies.

UI/CHARM_DESC_27.Zh:
乔尼留下的祝福，将生命力化作蓝色生命血。

持有者能承受更多伤害，但无法通过聚集灵魂治疗自身。
UI/CHARM_DESC_27.En:
Joni's blessing converts vitality into blue Lifeblood.

The bearer can endure more damage, but cannot heal by focusing Soul.

Elderbug/ELDERBUG_INTRO_MAIN.Zh: 这口井下面，曾经有个叫圣巢的伟大王国。如今它成了废墟，仍有人为财富、荣耀或答案下去冒险。<page>你从泰拉带来的工具和本领，或许能帮你走得更远。可别忘了，那里的危险不只会伤到身体。<page>我见过归来的旅者失去记忆，也见过有人再没回来。无论你在寻找什么，都请给自己留一条回家的路。
Elderbug/ELDERBUG_INTRO_MAIN.En: Below this well stood a great kingdom called Hallownest. It is ruined now, yet travellers still descend for wealth, glory, or answers.<page>The tools and skills you brought from Terraria may take you further. Remember, though: not every danger there wounds the body.<page>I have seen travellers return without their memories, and others never return at all. Whatever you seek, leave yourself a road home.

CP3/GODSEEKER_WATERWAYS_AWAKE_1.Zh: 是尔辈唤醒了吾等，泰拉异乡人？<page>这王国败落的神明，正在吾等心中重现光辉。汝的故乡可曾有过如此盛景？<page>不要只顾凝视吾等的躯壳。吾等所追寻的，乃超越形体的伟大！
CP3/GODSEEKER_WATERWAYS_AWAKE_1.En: Was it you who woke us, outsider from Terraria?<page>The fallen gods of this kingdom shine again within our mind. Has your homeland known such splendour?<page>Do not merely stare at our shell. We seek greatness beyond form!

CP3/GODSEEKER_WATERWAYS_AWAKE_2.Zh: 泰拉异乡人，尔辈为何来到此处？为了力量，还是为了挑战神明？<page>拿上神明调谐器，去寻找强大的存在，以战斗让它们的共鸣传来。<page>若愿效劳，吾等便容许尔辈在此停留。好好珍惜这份恩准！
CP3/GODSEEKER_WATERWAYS_AWAKE_2.En: Outsider from Terraria, why have you come? For power, or to challenge gods?<page>Take the Godtuner. Seek mighty beings and let their resonance reach us through battle.<page>If you will serve, we permit you to remain. Value that favour!

CP3/GODSEEKER_WATERWAYS_AWAKE_NO_GODFIND.Zh: 泰拉异乡人，尔辈在看神明调谐器？真是贪心！<page>拿去吧。吾等已能追寻更高的共鸣。愿尔辈的探索，至少能为吾等带来值得聆听的神音。
CP3/GODSEEKER_WATERWAYS_AWAKE_NO_GODFIND.En: Terrarian outsider, eyeing the Godtuner? Such greed!<page>Take it. We pursue a higher resonance now. May your exploration at least bring us a divine sound worth hearing.

CP3/GODSEEKER_WATERWAYS_AWAKE_ALLGODS.Zh: 泰拉异乡人……诸神竟接连回应了尔辈的挑战。<page>吾等心灵充满了这座王国的力量，而其中还有汝带来的陌生回响。<page>也许力量，果真不能只由出身衡量。
CP3/GODSEEKER_WATERWAYS_AWAKE_ALLGODS.En: Terrarian outsider... the gods have answered your challenges, one after another.<page>Our mind is full of this kingdom's power, and a strange resonance you brought with you.<page>Perhaps strength truly cannot be measured by origin alone.

CP3/GODSEEKER_WATERWAYS_WHITEFLOWER.Zh: 贡品？泰拉人竟向吾等献上一朵异乡的花。<page>微小，纯洁，却不曾发出吾等熟悉的神音。它来自怎样的土地？<page>不，礼物既已献出，便由吾等保管。尔辈不要再提出冒昧的要求！
CP3/GODSEEKER_WATERWAYS_WHITEFLOWER.En: An offering? A Terrarian brings us a foreign flower.<page>Small and pure, yet without a divine voice we recognise. From what land did it come?<page>No. The offering is ours to keep. Make no impertinent demands!

CP3/GODSEEKER_ENGINE_2.Zh: 这泰拉挑战者，竟还敢向诸神举起异乡的武器！<page>众神既然容许尔辈踏入此地，必定已备下更严酷的试炼。<page>继续前进吧，让吾等看看尔辈还能坚持多久！
CP3/GODSEEKER_ENGINE_2.En: This Terrarian challenger still dares raise foreign weapons against the gods!<page>If the gods permit your presence, a harsher trial surely awaits.<page>Go on. Let us see how long you endure!

Nailmasters/SHEO_MEET.Zh: 来客人了！泰拉旅人，你溜进来是要干嘛？也许你跟我一样有发现新事物的兴趣。<page>我是席奥，曾经是骨钉大师。没错，变得更强、不断磨练骨钉技艺曾是我唯一的人生动力。<page>那大概是我生命中唯一的目标。但这种感觉逐渐淡去。现在我要寻找新的目标，能和我的灵魂对话，使我不断前进的东西。<page>所以我才隐居于此，打算掌握创造、绘画和雕刻的技艺……它们能给我带来不一样的愉悦。<page>我的话似乎没能打动你。你是在寻找骨钉大师席奥吗？你要学习骨钉之技？你一定要学的话我就传授给你……
Nailmasters/SHEO_MEET.En: A visitor! Why have you crept in here, Terrarian traveller? Perhaps, like me, you have a taste for discovering new things?<page>I am Sheo, and in a previous life I was a Nailmaster. Yes, the only thing that drove me was becoming stronger and honing my skills with a nail.<page>I imagined it was my one calling in life, but that feeling faded over time. Now I seek a new calling, something that speaks to my soul and compels me forward.<page>That’s why I spend my time here, secluded, trying to master the art of creation. Painting, sculpting... these things bring a different kind of pleasure.<page>Mmm. You don’t seem very moved by what I’ve said. Was it Sheo the Nailmaster you were looking for? Did you come to learn a Nail Art? I’ll teach you if you insist...

CP2/GRIMM_RITUAL_COMPLETE.Zh: 我的亲族分散在这些土地的各处，收集我们……种族特有的精华，梦之火焰。<page>寻找我的亲族，收集它们的火焰并带回来给我。我们便能一同创造奇迹。<page>泰拉旅人别担心，你不会孤身一个完成这个任务。我的孩子会引导你找到火焰，并把那些燃烧的精华吸收到其体内。<page>和你一样，这孩子在任务中也是至关重要的。只有它陪伴在你身边时，火焰和我的亲族才会向你显形。
CP2/GRIMM_RITUAL_COMPLETE.En: Across these lands my kin now spread, harvesting that essence peculiar to my... breed, the flame in dream.<page>Seek my kin; claim their flame and return it to me. Together, marvels shall be achieved.<page>But don’t fret Terrarian traveller. For this task you won’t travel alone. My child shall guide you to the flame and gather within itself that burning essence.<page>Like you, the child plays key role in this task. Only with it by your side will the flame, and my kin, reveal themselves to you.

Minor NPC/JINN_ACCEPT.Zh: ……礼物……可怕的礼物……恶心……<page>但吉恩知道谁喜欢……吉恩的朋友。吃脏东西。喜欢脏东西。要接受。要给予。<page>发光的东西给泰拉旅人……给发光的东西好。减少了吉恩的负担。
Minor NPC/JINN_ACCEPT.En: ...Gift is... horrible gift. Disgusting...<page>But Jinn knows one who appreciates...Friend of Jinn. Eats nasties. Loves nasties. Shall accept. Shall provide.<page>Shinies for Terrarian traveller... Good to give Shinies. Less burden for Jinn.

Minor NPC/CLOTH_DEEPNEST_MEET.Zh: 你好啊泰拉旅人，你一看就是冒险家。我本来也是个冒险家，但这个恐怖的地方让我失去了这种自信。
Minor NPC/CLOTH_DEEPNEST_MEET.En: Greetings Terrarian traveller. You got the look of an adventurer alright. I’d call myself the same but this dreadful place makes me feel inadequate.

Minor NPC/CLOTH_TRAMWAY_DREAM_HAPPY.Zh: 我这是什么运气！千钧一发的时候泰拉旅人就出现了。而且战斗技艺娴熟无比！<page>它是个强大的战士，我从它的招式里获益良多。
Minor NPC/CLOTH_TRAMWAY_DREAM_HAPPY.En: Such luck! This Terrarian traveller appears at just the right moment. And what masterful skill it shows!<page>As a warrior it sets powerful precedent. I’d do well to learn from its form.

Minor NPC/XUN_HAVE_FLOWER.Zh: 她的坟墓在王后的旧宅中间，那是个遥远的地方，路上到处都是野兽。<page>路上小心。这样的泰拉旅人居然如此善良，让我的心悸动不已。
Minor NPC/XUN_HAVE_FLOWER.En: Her grave lies in the middle of the Queen’s old retreat, a far journey from here and the roads between are fraught with beasts.<page>Safe tiding on your journey. My heart does flutter to feel such kindness from a traveller from so far away.

Minor NPC/XUN_MEET.Zh: 啊啊啊……这个世界，这个残酷罪恶的世界。我为什么要醒来？我为什么要坚持？<page>泰拉旅人，你知道的悲剧肯定远没有我多。真爱阴阳两隔，永无再见之日。<page>我的爱人过世已久，躺在遥远的地方，被人埋葬。埋葬在她满心憎恨的族人中间，他们不承认我们的结合，拒绝我……这个外人。<page>可以这样吗？……哎呀哎呀。我可以提出请求吗？可以麻烦你吗？<page>陌生人，你能在她的坟前替我献上礼物吗？<page>礼物很小，但旅途漫长。她安息在同族之中，就在王后的苍翠园林附近。<page>你做得到吗？也许这是个不可能的任务？我疯了吗？愿意接受这种请求的陌生人一定会心怀几乎被人忘却的善良。
Minor NPC/XUN_MEET.En: Ahhhh.... Me’hon. This world. This cruel, sinful world. Why does che’ wake? Why does che’ persist?<page>Ahhh Le’mer, you could not know of tragedy as complete as che’s, true lovers stripped apart, two worlds that could not meet.<page>And now meled’lover, dead so long in time. Dead, so far away. Buried, moina? Ai. Amongst its hateful kin that did deny our union, that did reject che’s... outside-ness.<page>She doesn’t suppose?... Nahlo, Nahlo. Could che’ ask? Could che’ burden?<page>Le’mer, woulds’t you, coulds’t you deliver gift to her grave?<page>The gift is, maybe small? But the trek is long. She rests amongst her kind near our Queen’s lush refuge.<page>Would such a thing be done? Che’ asks perhaps impossible things? Mad things? For Le’mer to take up such quest would be a kindness che’ has near forgotten.

Minor NPC/WHITE_DEFENDER_OUTRO_5.Zh: 泰拉旅人，你出现在了我的梦中，真有意思。你高贵的举止风度让我想起了敬爱的国王。他回来之后，我会请求封你为骑士！这样我们就能愉快地冒险了……
Minor NPC/WHITE_DEFENDER_OUTRO_5.En: How funny that I see you in my dreams too, Terrarian traveller. Your noble bearing reminds me of our dear King. When he returns, I’ll ask him if you can become a Knight! What jolly adventures we will have...

Minor NPC/TISO_DREAM_TOWN.Zh: 这泰拉旅人肯定害怕我。我本来该就这么结果了它，但这样的结局也太遗憾了。
Minor NPC/TISO_DREAM_TOWN.En: This Terrarian traveller clearly fears me. I’d kill it right here, but it’d be too pitiful an end.

Minor NPC/BIGCAT_INTRO.Zh: 嗷嗯……泰拉旅人。你爬得真高。想在这些地方寻求知识？<page>这个破败的地方是沃姆的坟墓。曾有传闻说它死在了这里。但对这个远古生物来说死亡意味着什么呢？我觉得更像是一种转变。<page>正是那次事件后产生的生物建立了这个衰败的王国。
Minor NPC/BIGCAT_INTRO.En: Ohrm... Terrarian traveller. You climb high. Seek then knowledge of these lands?<page>This ashen place is grave of Wyrm. Once told, it came to die. But what is death for that ancient being? More transformation methinks.<page>This failed kingdom is product of the being spawned from that event.

Minor NPC/CLOTH_FUNG_MEET.Zh: 啊哈！泰拉旅人的脚步。你有冒险者的精神气儿，看来我们有很多相似之处。<page>在找危险的地方？那你就走对路了。<page>一个长脖子的家伙警告我说更下面的地方有个部落，她说那里的人都是战士，我等一场像样的战斗等得都心痒痒了。
Minor NPC/CLOTH_FUNG_MEET.En: Ah ha! The footsteps of a Terrarian traveller. You got the look of an adventurer, so we’ve much in common.<page>Searching for dangerous places aye? Well you’re on the right track.<page>A long necked critter warned me of a tribe deeper down. Warrior sorts, so she says and I’m itching for some serious combat.

Minor NPC/XUN_HAVE_FLOWER2.Zh: 她的坟墓在王后旧宅的中间，那是个遥远的地方，你也发现了旅途会有多危险。<page>注意安全……一定要多加小心，泰拉旅人。
Minor NPC/XUN_HAVE_FLOWER2.En: Her grave lies in the middle of the Queen’s old retreat. It’s a far journey from here and you’ve already learned how dangerous those paths can be.<page>Be safe...And be more careful. Me’hon.

Minor NPC/CLOTH_TRAMWAY_MEET.Zh: 哇！哎哟，你来自异乡，居然还能把所有野兽都干掉？<page>你可能觉得我是躲起来了，但根本不是这样。我只是在等合适的攻击时机！……不……我不能这么撒谎……我就是躲起来了。<page>这些可怕的畜生追着我跑，要不是你，天知道我还是不是已经没命了。<page>别的虫子看我个头大，就都以为我是厉害的战士，但这王国的野兽，我不知道能不能对付得了？……<page>……
Minor NPC/CLOTH_TRAMWAY_MEET.En: Oh! Ahh. Such a Terrarian traveller, yet you dealt with all of those beasts?<page>I wasn’t hiding, if that’s what you’re thinking. Just waiting for the right moment to pounce!...No... I can’t speak such a lie... I was hiding.<page>Those ghastly things chased me and I ran. If you hadn’t come along, who knows if I’d ever have survived.<page>Others take me for a fearsome warrior, what with my impressive size, but this kingdom’s beasts, I wonder if I’m just no match for them?...<page>...

Minor NPC/GIRAFFE_DREAM.Zh: 这泰拉旅人看起来挺好吃。我是不是该吃掉它呢？这里的其他东西一点味道都没有。
Minor NPC/GIRAFFE_DREAM.En: This Terrarian traveller looks tasty. I wonder, should I eat it? The others around here were awfully bland.

Elderbug/ELDERBUG_BLACK_EGG_OPENED.Zh: 我听到井里传来一声刺耳的嚎叫。这声音回荡在我的脑海中，让我茫然无措。<page>我一开始以为是什么肮脏的野兽死去了，但这声音听起来与以往的并不相同……给我一种神圣的感觉？泰拉旅人，发生了什么事？<page>不，不要告诉我。如果有什么阴谋正在酝酿，我或许还是不知道的好。
Elderbug/ELDERBUG_BLACK_EGG_OPENED.En: I heard a piercing cry from the well. It echoed about my mind and left me all a daze.<page>I’d say it was a foul beast’s death, but this cry sounded different...divine? Has something happened Terrarian traveller?<page>No. Don’t tell me. If foul events are brewing, it’s probably better I don’t know.

Banker/BANKER_DREAM_SPA.Zh: ……哦不……别过来，可怕的泰拉旅人……
Banker/BANKER_DREAM_SPA.En: ...Oohh no... Leave me be, creepy Terrarian traveller...

Hunter/HUNTER_MEET.Zh: 泰拉旅人……看上去你对我毫无畏惧。你也是像我一样的猎人吗？<page>你能够理解内心之中这份想要潜伏，捕获猎物的冲动吗？那你就把我的日志拿去吧！它会帮到你的。一开始你可能很难理解上面写的是什么，等你成为一名经验老到的猎人之后，你就能看懂了。<page>去探索这块土地的更深处，猎捕栖息其中的野兽吧！向我证明你有拥有猎人印记的资格！
Hunter/HUNTER_MEET.En: Terrarian traveller... You approach fearless. Are you a hunter like me?<page>Do you feel the urge inside, to stalk, to kill, to understand?<page>Then take it! My journal. It will aid you. At first the text may seem difficult to discern, but a learned hunter will come to understand its words.<page>Venture the depths of this land and slay its beasts. Prove yourself worthy to bear the mark of Hunter.

Hunter/HUNTER_ENTRIES_COMPLETED.Zh: 所以你已经遇见过这块土地上所有的野兽了。真令人印象深刻！但你还有任务没完成，泰拉旅人。<page>继续狩猎吧，直到解锁我所有的笔记！只有这样，我才会承认你是跟我同一级别的猎人，到时候我会奖励你的。
Hunter/HUNTER_ENTRIES_COMPLETED.En: So, you’ve encountered all of the beasts in this land. Impressive! But one task remains, Terrarian traveller.<page>Keep hunting down creatures until you have deciphered all of my notes! Only then will I recognise you as my fellow Hunter and you shall receive your reward.

Hunter/HUNTER_CONVO_1.Zh: 泰拉旅人！你或许已经战胜了一些生物，但那只是个开始。<page>别磨蹭了，去探索世界的更深处，狩猎你看见的各种生物！
Hunter/HUNTER_CONVO_1.En: Terrarian traveller! You may have overcome a few creatures, but you are only just beginning.<page>Don’t delay, descend into the belly of this world and hunt down the life you find!

Hunter/HUNTER_CONVO_2.Zh: 啊……我就知道没有看错人，你有猎人的资质。圣巢的生物都会在你面前倒下。<page>不要停滞不前，泰拉旅人，还有更多的生物等着你去发现、跟踪、搏斗。
Hunter/HUNTER_CONVO_2.En: Ahhh... I knew I’d seen it right. That hunter’s quality. Hallownest’s creatures fall in your path.<page>Don’t stop now Terrarian traveller, many more there are to find, and stalk, and kill.

Stag/STAG_DEEPNEST.Zh: 啊，泰拉旅人……我们这是在哪儿？我从来没来过这个车站。里面飘荡着陌生的危险气息。让我赶紧带去安全的地方吧。
Stag/STAG_DEEPNEST.En: Ahh, Terrarian traveller... Where are we? I have never been to this station. It has a strange air of danger to it. Let me take you somewhere safer, quickly.

Stag/STAG_HOPE_1.Zh: 觉得我的老家怎么样，泰拉旅人？<page>里面也曾生气勃勃。鹿角虫们络绎不绝，互相讲述他们去过的地方，见过的旅人。<page>但从很久之前起，这里就只剩下我了。最后的鹿角虫。<page>但回到巢里……让我觉得气氛有点不一样。一丝气味，一点温暖，还是一种存在？<page>难道其他鹿角虫走向了更广阔的世界？
Stag/STAG_HOPE_1.En: What do you think of my old home, Terrarian traveller?<page>It was full of life, once. Stags coming and going, swapping stories of the places they’d been and the passengers they’d met.<page>For a long time now, I’ve considered myself the only one remaining. The last stag.<page>But being in the Nest again... there’s something in the air. A smell, or a warmth, or a presence perhaps?<page>Could it be, other stags have made their way out into the wider world?

Stag/STAG_REMEMBER_3.Zh: 泰拉旅人！我找到了！我出生和长大的鹿角虫之巢。<page>我不能私自回去，我要遵守职责去有虫子呼唤我的地方，但如果你想去看看那里的话，我就能带你去。<page>可能那里已经空无一人，但巢本身也值得一看！只要你发个话，我们就马上过去。
Stag/STAG_REMEMBER_3.En: Terrarian traveller! I’ve found it! The Stag Nest, where I was born and raised.<page>I’ve yet to go there again. My duty binds me to travel only where I am called, but if you wished to see it yourself, I could take you there.<page>None may remain to welcome us, but the nest is still a sight to behold! Give me the word, and we will go there at once.

Stag/STAG_RUINS2.Zh: 泰拉旅人，这里是国王驿站！自然是得名于圣巢的国王，正是国王下令建造了鹿角虫道和各个驿站。<page>国王从未亲自踏足鹿角虫道，但我听说他是威风凛凛的虫子，容光焕发，亮得你根本没法直视。
Stag/STAG_RUINS2.En: Terrarian traveller, we stand in the King’s Station! Named of course for the King of Hallownest, he who ordered the building of the stagways and stations.<page>The King never rode the stagways himself, but I’ve heard he was a glorious bug to behold, bright and radiant in visage, so much so it hurt to look at him.

Stag/STAG_TRAVEL_1.Zh: 准备好出发了吗，泰拉旅人？

Stag/STAG_HIDDEN.Zh: 啊！在世界的底部居然隐藏了这样一座车站！<page>我在听到这里的铃声响起之前，还不知道鹿角虫道竟然建造到了这么深的地方。泰拉旅人，你确实发现了不可思议的东西！<page>虽然我已经很老了，但这个世界仍在不断地给我带来惊喜……
Stag/STAG_HIDDEN.En: Ah! What station is this, hidden all the way at the bottom of the world?<page>Until I heard the bell calling, I didn’t even know the Stagways travelled so deep. You’ve discovered something quite astounding, Terrarian traveller!<page>No matter how old I grow, the world still keeps surprises like this stowed away...

Stag/STAG_MEET.Zh: 你好，泰拉旅人！上次听到车站响铃已经是很久之前的事了。铃声在鹿角虫道上回响，让我找到了你。<page>我在这许多年里变得僵硬又疲倦，还忘记了很多东西。但只要听到铃声我就会回来。<page>鹿角虫道贯穿圣巢。如果你想用它们旅行，在站台上招呼我就好。我会帮你去你想去的地方。
Stag/STAG_MEET.En: Greetings, Terrarian traveller! It’s been an age since I last heard the ringing of a station bell. It echoed down the stagways and called me to you.<page>I’ve grown stiff and tired after all this time and I’ve forgotten much, but the sound of the bell will always call me back.<page>These stagways stretch the depths of Hallownest. If you want to travel them, hail me from the platform. I will take you where you need to go.

Ghosts/100NAIL_TALK.Zh: 泰拉旅人，你喜欢我的骨钉吗？我只持有三根，远不如传说中所描述的多。<page>但是！它们一根比一根锋利，只需要其中一根我就可以击败你。
Ghosts/100NAIL_TALK.En: Do you like my nails Terrarian traveller? I carry only three, far less than legends may suggest.<page>Still! Each is sharper than the last and I’d require only one to cut you down.

Ghosts/PERPETOS_REPEAT.Zh: 你这样的泰拉旅人都能给人如此深刻的印象。我也觉得自己是个战士，但我甚至没有对你举起骨钉的勇气。
Ghosts/PERPETOS_REPEAT.En: You’re very impressive for such a Terrarian traveller. I’m something of a warrior myself, though even I’d hesitate to raise my nail against you.

Ghosts/GRAVEDIGGER_REPEAT.Zh: 泰拉旅人。你想做什么就去做。朝你的目标径直前进。<page>我不应该抱怨。就是你们这样的人让我们有生意可做。
Ghosts/GRAVEDIGGER_REPEAT.En: Do as you will Terrarian traveller. Cut a path toward your goal.<page>I shouldn’t complain. It’s your kind that keeps folks like me in business.

Ghosts/MAGNUS_REPEAT.Zh: 记住，泰拉战士，粉碎你的恐惧；消灭你的问题；碾碎你的敌人。
Ghosts/MAGNUS_REPEAT.En: Remember Terrarian traveller, crush your fears; crush your problems; crush your foes.

Ghosts/ATRA_TALK.Zh: 泰拉旅人，不要害怕。虽然我曾经被暴力与愤怒所支配，但在这个地方，平和的空气似乎让它们得以消停。
Ghosts/ATRA_TALK.En: Don’t fear Terrarian traveller. Though a violent rage once possessed me the peaceful air in this place seems to keep it at bay.

Ghosts/CASPIAN_TALK.Zh: 泰拉旅人，注意你内心的想法。扭曲的心灵会滋养黑暗的行为，而我的心比绝大部分人都要扭曲。<page>我曾认为这份扭曲会伴随我直到死亡，但我找到了这个拥有祥和氛围的林地。
Ghosts/CASPIAN_TALK.En: Beware your own mind Terrarian traveller. Twisted minds breed dark deeds and mine was more twisted than most.<page>I thought it would be my end, but instead I found this glade and with it a sort of peace.

Ghosts/GARRO_TALK.Zh: 泰拉旅人，你是战士吗？真正的战士是那些可以在风暴中站稳的人。
Ghosts/GARRO_TALK.En: Are you a warrior, Terrarian traveller? A true warrior is one who can stand strong in the midst of a storm.

Minor NPC/BRETTA_DIARY_ZOTE.Zh:
灰色王子的故事
井边又出现一位自称英雄的旅者，讲述自己如何战胜强敌。他贬低那位泰拉来的救主，把每一件功劳都揽到自己身上。少女听着故事，再一次把想象当成了了解。而那位异乡旅人早已继续自己的冒险，并不属于谁预先写好的爱情故事。
Minor NPC/BRETTA_DIARY_ZOTE.En:
The Grey Prince's Story
Another traveller appeared by the well, calling himself a hero and boasting of conquered foes.He belittled the Terrarian rescuer and claimed every triumph. Listening, the maiden again mistook imagination for understanding.The foreign traveller had already continued their adventure, belonging to no love story written for them.
